sources.full: Quann'Ra-Tioll Moorchlyne's Most Excellent Compilation of All the Realms Known Ioun Stones

itemEntry.name: Moorchlyne Ioun Stone
entriesTemplate: An Ioun Stone is a naturally occurring conduit to the Positive Energy Plane. Each stone has a distinctive color, shape, and magical resonance.

entriesTemplate.name: Ioun Bond
entries: A creature can form an Ioun bond with this stone by keeping it in physical contact or within 1 foot of itself for 7 consecutive days. The creature learns the stone's properties gradually during this period. An Ioun bond is a special form of attunement and doesn't count against the number of magic items to which a creature can normally be attuned. A creature can be bonded to any number of Ioun Stones, but it gains no benefit from two stones with the same color and shape unless a rule explicitly says otherwise.

entriesTemplate.name: Orbiting the Stone
entries: A bonded creature can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to toss the stone into the air, whereupon it orbits within 3 feet of the creature and confers its benefits. The creature can have any number of its bonded Ioun Stones in orbit. As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, the creature can seize and stow any number of its orbiting stones. A stone confers no benefit while it isn't orbiting, but its bond remains intact while it stays within 1 foot of its bonded creature.

An Ioun Stone taken into an extradimensional space, such as a {@item Bag of Holding|XDMG}, loses its bond. A bonded stone carried more than 1 foot from its creature by another creature also loses its bond.

entriesTemplate.name: Capturing and Damaging the Stone
entries: An orbiting stone is a Tiny object being worn by its bonded creature. It has AC 24, 10 Hit Points, and Resistance to all damage. A creature other than the bonded creature can take a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to grasp or net the stone by succeeding on a DC 24 Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check. On a success, the stone is separated from its bonded creature and its benefit ends.

entriesTemplate.name: Death and Rebonding
entries: When the bonded creature dies, its stones fall harmlessly unless it died from massive instantaneous harm. In that case, each orbiting stone is flung {@dice 1d4 * 10} feet in a random direction before falling. A creature returned to life must bond with its stones again.

variantrule.name: Bounded Ioun Stones
entries: For a campaign closer to the standard 2024 magic-item assumptions, an Ioun bond counts as normal attunement, and a creature can have no more than three Ioun Stones orbiting it at the same time. This optional restriction substantially reduces the power and importance of large Ioun Stone collections and isn't assumed elsewhere in this book.

variantrule.name: Ioun Stone Collections
entries: Ioun Stones respond to one another and to the life force of their bonded creature. Each functioning stone in orbit reduces the time required to form another Ioun bond by 1 day, to a minimum of 3 days.

A creature with twelve or more bonded Ioun Stones can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to send one orbiting stone to a creature it can see within 30 feet. There is a {@chance 50|50 percent|Rapid Bonding} chance that the stone accepts the new creature and bonds to it immediately; otherwise the stone begins the normal bonding process.

Large collections are conspicuous. Their light and movement normally prevent their bonded creature from hiding in darkness, and creatures of the Elemental Plane of Earth can sense a large collection at the DM's discretion.

variantrule.name: Flawed Ioun Stones
entries: Approximately one Ioun Stone in a thousand contains a deep crystalline flaw. A flawed stone retains its normal properties but also gains one or more effects from {@table Flawed Ioun Stone Effects|MECIounStones}. These effects aren't ordinary curses; they are uncontrolled conduits of Positive Energy.

A creature examining a stone has a 2 percent chance to detect a flaw. An expert jeweler who spends 8 hours and materials worth 5,000 gp has a 15 percent chance, but the examination can begin an Ioun bond at the DM's discretion. A flawed stone can also be detected by an effect that explicitly identifies one.

Once bonded, a flawed Ioun Stone can't be grasped, netted, or voluntarily stowed. {@spell Wish|XPHB} removes it automatically. A level 9 or higher spellcaster can cast {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} and roll percentile dice; the base success chance is 50 percent + 5 percentage points for each caster level above 9. On a success, the stone falls dormant. On a failure, either nothing happens or the stone immediately bonds to the caster, as the DM chooses.
A removed flawed stone should be destroyed or isolated. Carrying it near its former bonded creature can cause the bond to reform. A twinned flawed stone affects both bonded creatures.

variantrule.name: Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)
entries: An {@i Instant} Ioun Stone reacts faster than thought. Its effect needs no action to trigger, or is used as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to the event that sets it off, and it resolves before the triggering effect takes hold.

In the source material an Instant stone is defined as activating in less than one tenth of a segment - fast enough to interpose itself between a spell and its target. In 2024 terms, a stone with this type either works automatically or costs a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, and it never requires you to wait for your turn.

variantrule.name: Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)
entries: A {@i Boosting} Ioun Stone enlarges a resource you already have rather than granting a new power. Most store additional spells for you to cast, and the rest add Hit Points or raise the ceiling on some other pool.
Stored spells belong to the stone, not to you. If the stone stops orbiting you before you cast them, the spells are lost until it returns.

variantrule.name: Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)
entries: A {@i Permanent} Ioun Stone radiates a continuous field. Its benefit applies for as long as the stone orbits you, requires no action to maintain, and can't be switched off short of stowing the stone.
Permanent is the most common type among the defensive and ability-improving stones. Because the effect is continuous, it ends the moment the stone leaves orbit.

variantrule.name: Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)
entries: A {@i Voluntary} Ioun Stone does nothing until you deliberately call on it. Activating one normally costs a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, or the action named in the stone's own description.

The source material has you roll a d10 on activation to determine how many segments pass before the power manifests. That timing is folded into the action cost in this conversion; no extra roll is required.

variantrule.name: Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)
entries: A {@i Limited} Ioun Stone can be used only a stated number of times before it must rest and draw fresh Positive Energy. Its description gives the cadence - most commonly once per day, recharging at dawn.

Limited almost always appears together with {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}: you choose when to spend a use, and the stone stops answering once the uses are gone.

variantrule.name: Ioun Source Type: Single-Use (S)
entries: A {@i Single-Use} Ioun Stone is spent by using it. Once its effect resolves, the stone crumbles into fine dust and the Ioun bond ends.
The dust of a spent stone is still {@item Ioun Sand|MECIounStones} and retains value to anyone who builds Ioun-sand matrices.

variantrule.name: Ioun Source Type: Charge-Holding (C)
entries: A {@i Charge-Holding} Ioun Stone behaves like a {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)} stone, but it holds a finite number of charges that don't come back on their own.
When the last charge is spent, the stone turns gray and inert, or crumbles outright. A charge-holding stone that has gone gray keeps its bond but confers nothing.

variantrule.name: Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)
entries: A {@i Temporary} Ioun Stone exists to be destroyed. It absorbs damage, a spell, or another harmful effect on your behalf, and burns out once it has taken as much as it can hold.
A burned-out stone provides no further benefit and its bond ends. Until then, it works automatically - you don't choose which harm it intercepts unless its description says so.

variantrule.name: Ioun Source Type: Micro
entries: A {@i Micro} Ioun Stone is roughly a quarter of an inch across, far smaller than a typical stone. Its power is correspondingly reduced, briefer, or both, and its description states the diminished effect in full.
Micro stones orbit and bond exactly as other Ioun Stones do. Mages prize them as components for Ioun-sand matrices, where their small size is an advantage.
{@i Micro} is a size category rather than a behaviour, so it always accompanies one of the behavioural types.

variantrule.name: Ioun Source Type: Drusy
entries: A {@i Drusy} Ioun Stone is a smooth, geode-like spell reservoir associated with the archmage Ardrus Be-Ta'Ryu. Its dull outer crust crumbles away during bonding, revealing a coloured shell around an internal crystal cluster.
Every drusy stone stores exactly one spell of a fixed class and level. Drusy stones are always {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)|MECIounStones|Boosting (B)}.

variantrule.name: Ioun Source Type: Varies
entries: A stone marked {@i Varies} has no single behaviour of its own. Its type is inherited from whatever other stones it carries or imitates, and is determined when the stone is generated.
Consult the individual stones it is composed of to determine which Source Types apply.

item.name: Ioun Geode
entries: An Ioun geode is an unattractive conglomerate of dense crystal, usually about 1 foot across but sometimes more than 1 yard in diameter. Within its shell, {@dice 3d4} Ioun Stones lie enmeshed in a fine crystalline web and surrounded by {@item Ioun Sand|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: Opening the Geode
entries: Breaking the shell releases centuries of trapped Positive Energy. Each creature within 30 feet takes {@damage 6d12 + 8} Radiant damage. A creature protected against Positive Energy or succeeding on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw takes half as much damage. Afterward, roll once on {@table Ioun Stone Table Selector|MECIounStones} for each stone inside.

Ioun geodes form along the boundary between the Positive Energy Plane and the Quasi-Elemental Plane of Mineral. Most are cultivated or guarded by the plane's inhabitants, who consider their removal theft.

item.name: Ioun Sand
entries: This heavy, glittering material surrounds Ioun Stones inside an intact geode. A small bag is worth up to 1,000 gp. It sometimes forms natural vortices that can hold Ioun Stones.

A master spellcaster and jeweler can shape Ioun Sand into a robe, cloak, helm, bracer, gauntlet, wand, staff, halo, ring, pendant, torc, or similar matrix. An Ioun Stone placed in such a matrix remains there until deliberately removed and every numerical property it grants is doubled, including bonuses, ranges, damage, healing, capacities, and durations. The DM adjudicates properties that can't coherently be doubled.
Complete suits and devices holding several stones are among the rarest and most valuable magic items in existence.

item.name: Arackle of Siljameer Varooste
entries: This pendant of fused Ioun Stones hangs from a chain shaped from Ioun Sand. Siljameer Varooste and Quann'Ra-Tioll Moorchlyne created it with Crystalle at the boundary of the Positive Energy Plane. It requires 7 consecutive days to attune.

entries.name: Continuous Properties
entries: While wearing the Arackle, you gain the full properties of {@item Ioun Stone #014, Dusty Rose Prism|MECIounStones} and {@item Ioun Stone #017, Orange Prism|MECIounStones}. These properties don't require the Arackle to orbit.

entries.name: Activation
entries: Once per day, you can speak the command words {@i Arum-Jazzalle} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and roll on {@table Arackle Effect|MECIounStones}. Unless the table says otherwise, an effect lasts 8 hours. After you have worn the Arackle continuously for 30 days, you can increase or decrease the d20 roll by up to 2. Other Ioun Stones that increase ability scores or levels confer no such increase while the Arackle is active.

entries.name: Changeling Matrix
entries: After you have remained attuned for 6 months, the Arackle also gains the daily property of {@item Ioun Stone #122, Brilliant Green Multi-Faceted Cylinder|MECIounStones}. This property functions independently of the activation roll.

entries.name: Ioun Greed
entries: A creature exposed to the Arackle's beauty takes a -4 penalty to any saving throw made to resist supernatural or overwhelming greed for it. At the DM's discretion, an obsessed creature may lie, steal, betray, or kill to possess it.

item.name: Ioun Stone #007, Pale Green Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: While this pale green prism orbits your head, you gain one level in one of your classes, including its Hit Die, Hit Point increase, class features, Spell Slots, and other benefits. You must meet the normal multiclass prerequisites if you gain the level in a new class. The DM decides how any choice normally made when gaining that level is resolved when the stone first bonds to you. You lose all benefits of the granted level while the stone isn't orbiting, and you can't use another pale green prism at the same time. The stone can raise your total level above 20.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: A super-charged prism grants two levels instead of one. If you have more than one class, the DM can instead have it grant one level in each class. This version is an artifact. See {@item Ioun Stone #007, Pale Green Prism (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #008, Clear Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You require no food or drink while this clear spindle orbits your head. If you consume no food for 30 consecutive days while relying on the stone, you gain 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|TGTT}. This level can't be removed until you eat normally for 7 consecutive days.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #009, Incandescent Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You don't need to breathe while this incandescent spindle orbits your head. You are immune to inhaled poisons and other harmful gases. When you take Acid or Poison damage from a breath weapon, you have Resistance to that damage; if another feature already gives you Resistance to it, you instead take one-quarter of the damage.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #010, Pearly White Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: While this pearly white spindle orbits your head and you have at least 1 Hit Point, you regain 5 Hit Points every 10 minutes. The stone can restore a number of Hit Points equal to your Hit Point maximum between Long Rests. It can restore only damage you took while it was orbiting.

entries.name: Regrowing Body Parts
entries: If a body part was severed while the stone orbited you, the stone regrows it in the following time: finger or toe, 30 minutes; hand or foot, 1 hour; forearm or lower leg, 2 hours; entire arm, 4 hours; entire leg, 8 hours; massive torso damage, 7 days. Decapitation still kills you immediately.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: A super-charged spindle restores 10 Hit Points every 10 minutes and is an artifact. See {@item Ioun Stone #010, Pearly White Spindle (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #011, Pale Lavender Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When found, this pale lavender ellipsoid can absorb 25 spell levels. When a spell of level 4 or lower would affect you, the stone absorbs the spell without requiring an action, and the spell has no effect on you. If you are the spell's only target, the spell is canceled. The stone loses charges equal to the spell's level (1 charge for a cantrip). If it lacks enough charges, it has no effect on that spell. At 0 charges, it becomes {@item Ioun Stone #015, Dull Gray Stone|MECIounStones|a dull gray stone}.

entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When found, this lavender and green ellipsoid can absorb 50 spell levels. When a spell of level 5 through 8 would affect you, the stone absorbs the spell without requiring an action, and the spell has no effect on you. If you are the spell's only target, the spell is canceled. The stone loses charges equal to the spell's level. If it lacks enough charges, it has no effect on that spell. At 0 charges, it becomes {@item Ioun Stone #015, Dull Gray Stone|MECIounStones|a dull gray stone}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #013, Vibrant Purple Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)|MECIounStones|Boosting (B)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When this vibrant purple prism first bonds to you, it has a spell-level capacity of 7. A creature can cast a spell into the stone by touching it as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect other than being stored, and the combined levels of spells stored can't exceed the capacity. A creature can cast a spell stored in the stone if the spell is on one of that creature's class spell lists, using the original caster's spell attack modifier and save DC. The spell then leaves the stone. Spells remain stored while the stone isn't orbiting.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: A super-charged prism has a capacity of 11 spell levels and is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #013, Vibrant Purple Prism (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #014, Dusty Rose Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while this dusty rose prism orbits your head. The saving throw bonus doesn't apply to unattended objects or other magic items in your possession.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The bonuses to AC and saving throws are +2 instead. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #014, Dusty Rose Prism (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #014, Dusty Rose Prism (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while this dusty rose prism orbits your head. The saving throw bonus doesn't apply to unattended objects or other magic items in your possession.
The bonuses to AC and saving throws are +2 instead.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #014, Dusty Rose Prism|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #015, Dull Gray Stone
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)|MECIounStones|Boosting (B)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This burned-out stone has no benefit for a creature without psionic power. A bonded creature with a pool of Psi Points increases its maximum number of Psi Points by 10 while the stone orbits. A creature with Psionic Energy Dice instead gains two additional dice of its normal size. No creature can gain more than 50 Psi Points or ten Psionic Energy Dice from multiple dull gray stones.
Certain denizens of the Elemental Plane of Mineral and {@item Ioun Stone #245, Glowing Rose Star|MECIounStones} can restore a burned-out stone.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #016, Dark Blue Rhomboid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks while this dark blue rhomboid orbits your head. You also have {@sense Truesight|XPHB} out to 5 feet and can't be surprised by a creature within that range.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #017, Orange Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When you cast a spell using a Spell Slot while this orange prism orbits your head, treat the spell as though it were cast with a slot one level higher, to a maximum of level 9, without expending the higher-level slot. If the spell gains no benefit from a higher-level slot, increase one numerical range, area, or duration of the spell by 25 percent instead. This stone doesn't grant additional Spell Slots or prepared spells.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #018, Blue and Green Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to surround yourself with a 5-foot Emanation of breathable air for 1 minute. The Emanation moves with you and allows creatures in it to breathe normally underwater or in another noncorrosive liquid.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #019, Brass Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)|MECIounStones|Boosting (B)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When you finish a Long Rest while this brass lozenge is orbiting, you gain {@dice 2d4 + 2} Temporary Hit Points. They last until the start of your next Long Rest or until the stone ceases to orbit you.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: You instead gain {@dice 4d4 + 4} Temporary Hit Points. A super-charged stone is rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #019, Brass Lozenge (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #019, Brass Lozenge (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)|MECIounStones|Boosting (B)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When you finish a Long Rest while this brass lozenge is orbiting, you gain {@dice 2d4 + 2} Temporary Hit Points. They last until the start of your next Long Rest or until the stone ceases to orbit you.
You instead gain {@dice 4d4 + 4} Temporary Hit Points.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #019, Brass Lozenge|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #020, Bright Silver Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to enter the Border Ethereal for 1 hour. You can bring worn and carried equipment weighing no more than 200 pounds. You remain faintly visible from the plane you left and can end the effect early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You are subject to creatures and hazards on the Border Ethereal.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #021, Bright White Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You have Resistance to Acid damage and a +1 bonus to saving throws against acid while this bright white rectangle orbits your head. After applying Resistance, reduce Acid damage you take by the number of damage dice rolled, to a minimum of 1 damage per die.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #022, Brown Rhomboid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can cast {@spell Gaseous Form|XPHB} on yourself from the stone, requiring no Material components or Concentration. The spell lasts 1 minute, and you can end it early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. The spell affects up to 200 pounds of your worn and carried equipment.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #023, Cerulean Blue Rhomboid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain the benefits of {@spell Freedom of Movement|XPHB} for 1 minute.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #024, Clear Pink Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This clear pink sphere has 5 charges. If you die while it orbits your head, your soul enters the stone if it is free and willing. While held there, your soul is treated as though you had died no more than 1 day ago for the purpose of magic that returns you to life, regardless of the actual time elapsed. When such magic returns you to life, the stone expends 1 charge and you gain 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|TGTT}. At 0 charges, the stone becomes dull gray.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #025, Clear Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)|MECIounStones|Boosting (B)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This clear prism has a spell-level capacity of 4. Only level 1 and 2 spells can be stored, and the stone can't hold the same spell more than once. A creature can cast a spell into the stone by touching it as the spell is cast. Any creature bonded to the stone can later cast a stored spell, using the lower of its own or the original caster's spell attack modifier and save DC. The spell then leaves the stone.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: A super-charged prism can store level 3 and 4 spells as well as level 1 and 2 spells. It is very rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #025, Clear Prism (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #025, Clear Prism (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)|MECIounStones|Boosting (B)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This clear prism has a spell-level capacity of 4. Only level 1 and 2 spells can be stored, and the stone can't hold the same spell more than once. A creature can cast a spell into the stone by touching it as the spell is cast. Any creature bonded to the stone can later cast a stored spell, using the lower of its own or the original caster's spell attack modifier and save DC. The spell then leaves the stone.
A super-charged prism can store level 3 and 4 spells as well as level 1 and 2 spells.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #025, Clear Prism|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #026, Clear Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Whenever a spell or another magical effect would affect you, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 20, you are unaffected. A super-charged clear sphere negates the effect on a roll of 19 or 20 and is very rare. If a normal and super-charged sphere orbit you together, the effect is negated on a roll of 18-20. No other clear spheres improve this chance.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #027, Copper Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You can read and understand magical writing, including spell scrolls, while this copper rectangle orbits your head. The stone doesn't grant the ability to cast a spell from a scroll and offers no protection from a cursed text.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #028, Deep Black Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You can see normally through magical and nonmagical Darkness to a range of 60 feet while this deep black sphere orbits your head. Within that range, you see only in shades of gray.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #029, Deep Purple Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} out to 60 feet while this deep purple prism orbits your head. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #030, Flickering Snowflake
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You have Resistance to Cold damage and a +1 bonus to saving throws against cold while this flickering snowflake orbits your head. After applying Resistance, reduce Cold damage you take by the number of damage dice rolled, to a minimum of 1 damage per die.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #031, Gold Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to enter the Astral Plane for 10 minutes. You can bring your worn and carried equipment and can end the effect early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. When the effect ends, you return to the space you left or the nearest unoccupied space. You are subject to creatures and hazards on the Astral Plane.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #032, Green Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You have Resistance to Poison damage and a +1 bonus to saving throws against gas, vapor, and breath weapons while this green sphere orbits your head. After applying Resistance, reduce Poison damage you take from those sources by the number of damage dice rolled, to a minimum of 1 damage per die.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #033, Light Blue Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When you hear a spoken language you don't know while this light blue prism orbits your head, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a roll of 11 or higher, you understand the speaker. A creature that hears you speak a language it doesn't know can make the same roll to understand you. After you converse continuously in a language for 1 hour, you can speak and understand that language while the stone continues to orbit you.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #034, Maroon Star
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become immune to Piercing and Slashing damage from nonmagical melee weapons for 1 minute. You are also immune to damage from natural melee attacks made by creatures of CR 5 or lower. The protection doesn't apply to ranged attacks.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The immunity to natural melee attacks applies to creatures of CR 8 or lower. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #034, Maroon Star (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #034, Maroon Star (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become immune to Piercing and Slashing damage from nonmagical melee weapons for 1 minute. You are also immune to damage from natural melee attacks made by creatures of CR 5 or lower. The protection doesn't apply to ranged attacks.
The immunity to natural melee attacks applies to creatures of CR 8 or lower.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #034, Maroon Star|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #035, Blue Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws while this blue cube orbits your head. You also have Advantage on saving throws against madness.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #036, Pale Yellow Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain the ability to move across any noncorrosive liquid surface as if it were harmless solid ground for 1 minute.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The effect lasts 10 minutes. A super-charged stone is rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #036, Pale Yellow Lozenge (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #036, Pale Yellow Lozenge (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain the ability to move across any noncorrosive liquid surface as if it were harmless solid ground for 1 minute.
The effect lasts 10 minutes.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #036, Pale Yellow Lozenge|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #037, Puce Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to read the surface thoughts of creatures you can see within 60 feet for 3 rounds. You can read one creature each round and can take no other action while doing so. An unwilling creature can make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw to prevent its thoughts from being read that round.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #038, Pulsing Red Star
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You have Resistance to Fire damage and a +1 bonus to saving throws against fire while this pulsing red star orbits your head. After applying Resistance, reduce Fire damage you take by the number of damage dice rolled, to a minimum of 1 damage per die.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #039, Rainbow Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can cast {@spell Levitate|XPHB} on yourself from the stone, requiring no Concentration. The spell lasts 1 minute.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The spell lasts 10 minutes. A super-charged stone is rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #039, Rainbow Ellipsoid (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #039, Rainbow Ellipsoid (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can cast {@spell Levitate|XPHB} on yourself from the stone, requiring no Concentration. The spell lasts 1 minute.
The spell lasts 10 minutes.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #039, Rainbow Ellipsoid|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #040, Rainbow Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can cast {@spell Polymorph|XPHB} on yourself from the stone, requiring no Concentration. The form must be familiar to you and within one Size of your normal form. The effect lasts 10 minutes, during which you can assume up to two different eligible forms as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. When you return to your normal form at the end of the duration, you regain {@dice 1d12} Hit Points.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #041, Bright Silver Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You have Resistance to Lightning damage and a +1 bonus to saving throws against electricity while this bright silver rod orbits your head. After applying Resistance, reduce Lightning damage you take by the number of damage dice rolled, to a minimum of 1 damage per die.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #042, Bright Silver Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to establish a one-way telepathic link with a creature you know on the same plane of existence. For 3 rounds, you can send it up to 25 words on each of your turns. The creature recognizes you as the sender but can't reply.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The contacted creature can reply with up to 25 words on each of its turns. A super-charged stone is very rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #042, Bright Silver Sphere (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #042, Bright Silver Sphere (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to establish a one-way telepathic link with a creature you know on the same plane of existence. For 3 rounds, you can send it up to 25 words on each of your turns. The creature recognizes you as the sender but can't reply.
The contacted creature can reply with up to 25 words on each of its turns.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #042, Bright Silver Sphere|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #043, Silvery Mirrored Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws against being {@condition Petrified|XPHB} while this silvery mirrored cube orbits your head. When you succeed on a saving throw against a gaze effect, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a roll of 17 or higher, the effect is reflected at its source, which must make any saving throw normally required by its own effect.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #044, Soft Black Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This soft black rectangle has 7 charges. When an attack or effect would reduce your Hit Point maximum, drain a level or Hit Die, or otherwise drain your life energy, the stone negates that part of the effect and expends 1 charge. It expends 2 charges against the life-draining attack of a vampire or specter.

At 0 charges, the stone doesn't become dull gray. Instead, once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become immune to life-draining effects for 1 minute. Exposing the stone to the Positive Energy Plane for 10 minutes restores {@dice 2d4 + 2} charges.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #045, Yellow Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can make the stone shed Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 5 feet, or extinguish the light. The light also ends when the stone ceases to orbit you.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #046, Green Star
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws against poison and the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition while this green star orbits your head.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The bonus is +2 instead. A super-charged stone is rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #046, Green Star (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #046, Green Star (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws against poison and the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition while this green star orbits your head.
The bonus is +2 instead.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #046, Green Star|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #047, Bright Blue Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against being {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} while this bright blue lozenge orbits your head. If you are Paralyzed for a duration measured in rounds despite this bonus, halve the duration, rounding down to a minimum of 1 round.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #048, Dazzling White Star
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain the benefits of {@spell Protection from Evil and Good|XPHB} for 1 minute, requiring no Concentration.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The protection also affects allies while they are within a 5-foot Emanation originating from you. A super-charged stone is very rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #048, Dazzling White Star (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #049, Pulsing White Rhomboid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, while presenting a Holy Symbol, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to censure Undead. Each Undead of your choice within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw against DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Wisdom modifier. On a failed save, it has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions for 1 minute and must spend its turns moving away from you. This effect ends early on a creature if it takes damage, if you have the Incapacitated condition, or if you die.

If you have a Cleric or Paladin feature that censures or turns Undead, calculate any level-based effect of that feature as though you were one level higher. Otherwise, this stone can't destroy Undead outright.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #050, Amber and Red Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Each magic item in your possession other than an Ioun Stone gains a +1 bonus to its saving throws while this amber and red spindle orbits your head.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #051, Mottled Yellow and White Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to ward yourself against creatures native to the Elemental Plane of Earth and its adjacent para-elemental and quasi-elemental planes for 1 minute. Such creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you, and you have Advantage on saving throws against their abilities. They can't willingly move within 5 feet of you unless they first succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The ward affects creatures native to every Elemental Plane and all associated para-elemental and quasi-elemental planes. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #051, Mottled Yellow and White Cube (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #052, Clear Teardrop
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to sense the direction, but not the location, of every Undead within 60 feet that isn't behind Total Cover. For 1 minute, the stone warns you with a mental flash whenever an Undead enters that range; a brighter flash indicates a more powerful creature.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #053, Dark Green Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, after you fail a D20 Test, roll damage, or see a magic item in your possession fail a saving throw, you can reroll the roll and must use the new result. After the stone is used, roll {@dice 1d100}. It crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower. Increase this chance by 10 for each previous use of the stone.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: You can instead force a creature you can see to reroll an attack roll, saving throw, ability check, or damage roll. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #053, Dark Green Ellipsoid (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #053, Dark Green Ellipsoid (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect

After the stone is used, roll {@dice 1d100}. It crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower. Increase this chance by 10 for each previous use of the stone.
You can instead force a creature you can see to reroll an attack roll, saving throw, ability check, or damage roll.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #053, Dark Green Ellipsoid|MECIounStones}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #054, Pale Green Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain the benefits of {@spell Nondetection|XPHB} for 1 minute.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #055, Dull Orange Rhomboid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to surround yourself with the effect of {@spell Shield|XPHB} for 1 minute. Unlike the spell, this protection applies against attacks from every direction.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #056, Emerald Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)|MECIounStones|Boosting (B)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This emerald ellipsoid gives you a reserve of 5 Hit Points while it orbits your head. Damage reduces your normal Hit Points first. While you have 0 normal Hit Points and reserve Hit Points remain, you don't have the Unconscious condition and don't make Death Saving Throws at the start of your turns. Damage from a melee attack reduces the reserve; other damage doesn't reduce it but causes failed Death Saving Throws as normal. If the reserve reaches 0 while you have 0 normal Hit Points, you fall Unconscious and begin making Death Saving Throws normally. The reserve is restored when you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The reserve contains 10 Hit Points. A normal and super-charged emerald ellipsoid can function together, for a total reserve of 15 Hit Points. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #056, Emerald Ellipsoid (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #056, Emerald Ellipsoid (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)|MECIounStones|Boosting (B)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This emerald ellipsoid gives you a reserve of 5 Hit Points while it orbits your head. Damage reduces your normal Hit Points first. While you have 0 normal Hit Points and reserve Hit Points remain, you don't have the Unconscious condition and don't make Death Saving Throws at the start of your turns. Damage from a melee attack reduces the reserve; other damage doesn't reduce it but causes failed Death Saving Throws as normal. If the reserve reaches 0 while you have 0 normal Hit Points, you fall Unconscious and begin making Death Saving Throws normally. The reserve is restored when you finish a Long Rest.
The reserve contains 10 Hit Points. A normal and super-charged emerald ellipsoid can function together, for a total reserve of 15 Hit Points.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #056, Emerald Ellipsoid|MECIounStones}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #057, Marbled Blue and White Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: While this sphere orbits your head, each of your other orbiting Ioun Stones has AC 26, 20 Hit Points, and a +2 bonus to saving throws. When another creature succeeds on a check to grasp or net one of those stones, there is a {@chance 50|50 percent|Guardian Interception} chance the attempt fails anyway. The Guardian is always affected first by an effect that would damage multiple stones, and its protection ends immediately if it is destroyed.
The Guardian continually changes the apparent color and shape of your other stones, concealing their identities and properties. You can always distinguish your stones from one another.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #058, Ochre Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You can see in every direction while this ochre spindle orbits your head. A creature gains no Advantage for attacking you merely because it is behind you, and visible creatures behind you can't surprise you. The stone doesn't reveal Invisible creatures or allow you to see through obscurement.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #059, Pale Aquamarine Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition while this pale aquamarine prism orbits your head, including saving throws against a dragon's Frightful Presence.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #060, Pale Turquoise Star
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, when you make an ability check, you can add 2 to the roll after rolling the d20 but before the outcome is determined. If the check uses a skill available to the Rogue class in which you have proficiency, you also add 1 to the roll.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #061, Pearl Brown Rhomboid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: The stone has 2 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dawn. When you make a Strength check to bend, break, lift, or force an object, you can expend 1 charge to add 2 to the roll after rolling the d20 but before the outcome is determined.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The bonus is +4 instead. A super-charged stone is rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #061, Pearl Brown Rhomboid (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #061, Pearl Brown Rhomboid (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries: The stone has 2 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dawn. When you make a Strength check to bend, break, lift, or force an object, you can expend 1 charge to add 2 to the roll after rolling the d20 but before the outcome is determined.
The bonus is +4 instead.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #061, Pearl Brown Rhomboid|MECIounStones}.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #062, Brilliant Green Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to double your Speed for 1 minute. Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage during this time.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: While the effect lasts, you can make one additional attack whenever you take the Attack action. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #062, Brilliant Green Cylinder (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #062, Brilliant Green Cylinder (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to double your Speed for 1 minute. Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage during this time.
While the effect lasts, you can make one additional attack whenever you take the Attack action.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #062, Brilliant Green Cylinder|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #063, Red Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Your carrying capacity is doubled while this red prism orbits your head. If the campaign uses the Encumbrance variant, treat the weight of equipment you carry as halved when determining whether you are encumbered instead of doubling the variant's weight thresholds; these benefits don't combine.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #064, Sky Blue Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can cast {@spell Fly|XPHB} on yourself from the stone, requiring no Concentration. The spell lasts 1 minute.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The spell lasts 10 minutes. A super-charged stone is very rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #064, Sky Blue Sphere (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #064, Sky Blue Sphere (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can cast {@spell Fly|XPHB} on yourself from the stone, requiring no Concentration. The spell lasts 1 minute.
The spell lasts 10 minutes.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #064, Sky Blue Sphere|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #065, Rainbow Star
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become camouflaged for 10 minutes. While you move no more than 30 feet on your turn, you have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition. Making an attack or casting a spell doesn't end the effect, but you lose the condition until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #066, Black Rhomboid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, when you are hit by a weapon attack or another physical attack, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to cause the attack to deal no damage to you and impose none of its other effects.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #067, Pale Blue Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed while this pale blue lozenge orbits your head, even while wearing armor. You gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity checks made while climbing. If you have Expertise in {@skill Athletics|XPHB} or {@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}, the bonus increases to +4.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #068, Pink Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to create a repulsion field for 1 minute. A creature of CR 1/4 or lower can't willingly move within 5 feet of you or hit you with a melee attack. A creature in the area when the field appears must immediately use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, if available, to move to the nearest unoccupied space outside it. The field doesn't impede ranged attacks.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #069, Deep Blue Faceted Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Whenever you roll damage for a spell you cast while this deep blue faceted egg orbits your head, add 1 to each damage die, to a minimum result of 2 on each die. This benefit doesn't apply to a spell cast from a magic item unless you created the item or scribed the spell scroll while the stone orbited you.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #070, Pale Green Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become immune to damage from weapon attacks and natural weapons for 1 minute. Roll {@dice 1d100} when you activate the stone to determine what can overcome the immunity. Spells and other nonweapon effects ignore this immunity.

entries.caption: Weapon Immunity
rows: Weapon attacks made with a +1 or better magic weapon, or natural weapons of a CR 4 or higher creature
Weapon attacks made with a +2 or better magic weapon, or natural weapons of a CR 6 or higher creature
Weapon attacks made with a +3 magic weapon, or natural weapons of a CR 8 or higher creature

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #071, Blue Faceted Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to target a creature within 20 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be lifted and spun violently for 3 rounds. During this time, it has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} conditions and hovers in its space. Afterward, it has Disadvantage on D20 Tests for up to 3 rounds, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns and ending the aftereffect on a success.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #072, Slate Blue Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: While this slate blue prism orbits your head, treat your Cleric and Paladin levels as 2 higher when calculating the effects and available uses of Channel Divinity, Lay On Hands, and other explicitly divine class features. Your Lay On Hands pool increases by 10 Hit Points. Once per Long Rest, you can use Channel Divinity or Lay On Hands without expending a use or reducing the pool. This stone doesn't grant a feature you don't have.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: A number of times per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus, when you cast a spell that restores Hit Points, you can cause each healing die to restore its maximum value instead of rolling. A super-charged stone is an artifact. See {@item Ioun Stone #072, Slate Blue Prism (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #072, Slate Blue Prism (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: While this slate blue prism orbits your head, treat your Cleric and Paladin levels as 2 higher when calculating the effects and available uses of Channel Divinity, Lay On Hands, and other explicitly divine class features. Your Lay On Hands pool increases by 10 Hit Points. Once per Long Rest, you can use Channel Divinity or Lay On Hands without expending a use or reducing the pool. This stone doesn't grant a feature you don't have.
A number of times per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus, when you cast a spell that restores Hit Points, you can cause each healing die to restore its maximum value instead of rolling.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #072, Slate Blue Prism|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #073, Gold Rhomboid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, when a creature within your reach misses you with a melee attack, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make one melee weapon attack against it with a +3 bonus to the attack roll. On a hit, the weapon deals its maximum damage instead of rolling its damage dice.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #074, Glowing Rose Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to AC while this glowing rose prism orbits your head. This bonus doesn't function while you wear magic medium or heavy armor, wield a magic shield, or wear a magic ring that grants a bonus to AC. It functions with light armor, natural armor, Dexterity, and Bracers of Defense.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #075, Purple Faceted Cone
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When you whisper while this purple faceted cone orbits your head, you can choose to have your voice heard clearly by one creature you can see within 100 feet as though you were beside it. You can hear that creature's whispered replies at the same distance.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #076, Clear Faceted Lens
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You can discern detail at extreme distance while this clear faceted lens orbits your head; an object 2,000 feet away appears as clear as one 20 feet away. Your ranged weapon attacks ignore Disadvantage imposed by long range, and you gain a +1 bonus to ranged weapon attack rolls against targets within the weapon's normal range.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #077, Green and Silver Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can identify any liquid, including a potion or poison, by tasting a drop. You gain a +2 bonus to any saving throw triggered by tasting the liquid.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules

item.name: Ioun Stone #078, White and Pink Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can spend 12 consecutive rounds resting while this sphere orbits your head. At the end, you gain the Hit Point, Hit Dice, and Exhaustion benefits of 12 hours of rest. You don't regain Spell Slots, change prepared spells, or regain any feature whose use normally requires a Short or Long Rest.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #079, Black Twisted Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to stop time for a moment. You immediately take one special turn during which you can move and take the Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Hide action. You can affect only yourself and objects you are wearing or carrying. During this movement, you can cross liquids and other surfaces that couldn't normally bear your weight without falling or sinking.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: You take two special turns instead of one. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #079, Black Twisted Hexagonal Rod (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #080, Yellow Twisted Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This stone has 2 charges. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 charge and target a Medium or smaller creature you can see within 60 feet. It must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be enclosed in an impervious stasis egg, sink 100 feet into the ground, and remain there for 10 days. The creature doesn't age, require sustenance, perceive its surroundings, or experience the passage of time. It returns safely to the surface when the duration ends. Before then, only physically excavating the egg, {@spell Wish|XPHB}, or similarly powerful magic can free it. At 0 charges, the stone crumbles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #081, Steel Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: While this steel lozenge orbits your head and you wear no armor and wield no shield, your base AC is 16 + your Dexterity modifier. This property doesn't function with Bracers of Defense but does function with a Ring of Protection.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The rare mithral form gives you a base AC of 18 + your Dexterity modifier and is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #081, Steel Lozenge (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #082, Blue and Green Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to empower the stone for 1 minute. When you cast a spell during this time, increase its duration by 50 percent, rounding up to the next round or minute as appropriate. A spell cast on you by another creature during this time gains the same increase.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: Affected spell durations are doubled instead. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #082, Blue and Green Cube (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to adapt yourself and your equipment to any Elemental, Para-Elemental, or Quasi-Elemental Plane for 24 hours. You can breathe, move, perceive, and survive the plane's ambient environmental conditions. The stone doesn't transport you, protect you from creatures or localized hazards, or grant any language.

entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Your body maintains a safe internal temperature while this lime green prism orbits your head, regardless of the ambient air temperature. This protection doesn't reduce damage from spells, breath weapons, direct contact with hazardous substances, or other sudden extremes.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to restore {@dice 3d4 + 4} Hit Points to yourself or a creature you touch.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The healing is {@dice 3d6 + 6}. A super-charged stone is rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #085, Bright White Lozenge (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to surround one hand with negative energy for 1 minute. While it lasts, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to make a melee spell attack using your highest mental ability against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d4 + 4} Necrotic damage.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The damage is {@damage 3d6 + 6}. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #086, Black Lozenge (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #087, Blue Dodecahedron

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to release a concussive pulse in a 10-foot Emanation. Each Medium or smaller creature of your choice in the area must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. A creature that rolls a 1 on the d20 also has the {@condition Stunned|TGTT} condition for 3 rounds.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The Emanation is 15 feet and can affect Large or smaller creatures weighing up to 800 pounds. A super-charged stone is very rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #087, Blue Dodecahedron (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries: You gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against disease and lycanthropy while this yellow ellipsoid orbits your head.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: You are immune to disease and lycanthropy. A super-charged stone is very rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #088, Yellow Ellipsoid (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #089, Blue Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)|MECIounStones|Boosting (B)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: A spellcaster can store one prepared spell of any level in this blue ellipsoid by casting the spell into it. The spell has no immediate effect. When storing it, the caster describes a trigger as for {@spell Contingency|XPHB}. When that trigger occurs while the stone orbits the caster, the stored spell takes effect without an action or components. The stone can't store another spell until the first is discharged.
