item.name: Ioun Stone #090, Bright Green Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: The stone has 2 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dawn. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 charge to touch and instantly corrode up to 10 pounds of nonmagical ferrous metal. An object worn or carried by another creature is unaffected unless the creature is willing.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The stone can corrode up to 100 pounds of ferrous metal. A super-charged stone is rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #090, Bright Green Spindle (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to create a disruptive net in a 5-foot Emanation for 3 rounds. A hostile creature that enters the Emanation or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or suffer the effects of {@spell Slow|XPHB} until it leaves the Emanation.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #092, Red Twisted Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: A creature within 60 feet of you that has Magic Resistance or a similar trait takes a -2 penalty to saving throws against spells you cast while this red twisted hexagonal rod orbits your head. This penalty applies after any Advantage granted by that trait.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The penalty is -4 instead. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #092, Red Twisted Hexagonal Rod (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #093, Pearl Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: After you handle a magic item for 10 minutes, you can roll {@dice 1d100}. If the result is equal to or lower than three times your level, you learn the item's properties and how to use them, as with {@spell Identify|XPHB}. The stone doesn't reveal curses and offers no protection from them. Whether the roll succeeds or fails, this stone can't examine that item again.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #094, Blue Twisted Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to empower the stone for 1 minute. When a damaging spell targets only you, it is deflected in a random direction. Roll {@dice 1d8} to determine the direction; the nearest eligible creature along that line becomes the spell's target, using the original caster's spell attack modifier and save DC. If there is no eligible creature, the spell is wasted. This property doesn't affect an area spell unless you were the spell's initial target, as with some lines of lightning.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #095, Red Multi-Faceted Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to surround one hand with a portal whose other end appears at a point you can see within 100 feet. For 1 minute, that hand can manipulate objects and deliver touch spells from the distant point. A melee attack or touch spell delivered through the portal uses your normal attack modifier.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: You can project both hands through the portal. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #095, Red Multi-Faceted Cylinder (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to surround one hand with a portal whose other end appears at a point you can see within 100 feet. For 1 minute, that hand can manipulate objects and deliver touch spells from the distant point. A melee attack or touch spell delivered through the portal uses your normal attack modifier.
You can project both hands through the portal.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #095, Red Multi-Faceted Cylinder|MECIounStones}.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #096, Black Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to target a creature within 20 feet and choose one ability score, skill or tool proficiency, Speed, sense, or nonlegendary trait it possesses. An unwilling target can make a DC 20 Charisma saving throw to prevent the effect. On a failure, or if it is willing, you gain the chosen score or capability for 1 minute, replacing your own value if the target's is higher. The DM determines whether a trait can be copied and how it functions for you. You can have only one stolen capability at a time.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #097, Red Faceted Pyramid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to emit sunlight in a 20-foot Emanation. Each Undead in the area takes {@damage 3d4 + 3} Radiant damage with no saving throw.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #098, Bright Rose Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Your ability scores can't be increased or reduced by any effect other than this stone while this bright rose prism orbits your head. This protection prevents both harmful reductions and beneficial increases.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #099, Balian's Yellow Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)|MECIounStones|Boosting (B)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This spindle increases one randomly determined ability score by 2, to a maximum of 22, for 12 hours. It then becomes dormant for 12 hours before rolling again. Roll {@dice 1d6} whenever a new active period begins.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #100, Pearl Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This pearl sphere has 4 charges. Once every 24 hours, you can expend 1 charge to duplicate any spell of level 6 or lower. You don't need to meet the spell's requirements or provide components, and the spell takes effect as part of the action used to activate the stone. Alternatively, the DM can allow another effect of comparable power. At 0 charges, the stone burns out and crumbles into dust. No effect, including {@item Ioun Stone #277, Lavender and Green Faceted Egg|MECIounStones} or {@spell Wish|XPHB}, can restore its charges.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: Five percent of pearl spheres contain multicolored sparks. Such a sphere has 2 charges, and each charge casts {@spell Wish|XPHB} instead. It remains an artifact. See {@item Ioun Stone #100, Pearl Sphere (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries: This pearl sphere has 2 charges. Once every 24 hours, you can expend 1 charge to duplicate any spell of level 6 or lower. You don't need to meet the spell's requirements or provide components, and the spell takes effect as part of the action used to activate the stone. Alternatively, the DM can allow another effect of comparable power. At 0 charges, the stone burns out and crumbles into dust. No effect, including {@item Ioun Stone #277, Lavender and Green Faceted Egg|MECIounStones} or {@spell Wish|XPHB}, can restore its charges.
Five percent of pearl spheres contain multicolored sparks. Its charges each cast {@spell Wish|XPHB} instead.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #100, Pearl Sphere|MECIounStones}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #101, Green Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and choose an Ioun Stone orbiting any creature within 30 feet. For 8 hours, this rod assumes the chosen stone's appearance and all its properties. If the copied stone has charges or a limited number of uses, the mimic has only 1 charge or use. A property that would transform, burn out, or destroy the copied stone instead ends the mimicry until the rod recharges.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #102, Red Faceted Egg

item.name: Ioun Stone #104, Deep Purple Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain penetrating vision for 3 rounds. During this time, you can see through up to 3 feet of earth or stone or 10 feet of wood as though it were transparent. You can't see through metal.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: You can see through 10 feet of earth or stone or 20 feet of wood. A super-charged stone is very rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #104, Deep Purple Hexagonal Rod (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #105, Red Faceted Cone
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to reduce your body mass to 10 pounds for 1 minute without changing your Size, equipment, Strength, or carrying capacity. Your falling damage is reduced to 0 during this time.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #106, Pearl Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)|MECIounStones|Boosting (B)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: The stone regains all 4 of its charges daily at dawn. While it orbits your head, you can expend 1 charge to cast any cantrip from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose each time you cast).

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #107, Silver and White Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to assume a gaseous, wraith-like form for 3 rounds. You and your equipment can pass through an opening as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. You have a Fly Speed of 20 feet, can hover, and are immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. You can't attack, cast spells, or manipulate objects in this form, and you revert early if you have the Incapacitated condition.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #108, Flashing Yellow Star
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: The stone records all Hit Points you lose to melee attacks while it orbits your head, glowing more brightly as the total rises. Once per day, when such an attack leaves you with 15 Hit Points or fewer but doesn't kill you outright, the stone immediately restores Hit Points to you equal to half the recorded total, rounded down, then erases the total. Removing the stone from orbit before it releases the energy erases the recorded total.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #109, White Tetragonal Cluster
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This stone appears as a shifting cluster of identical tetragonal crystals. Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and roll {@dice 1d4}. For 1 minute, one melee weapon you are holding gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number rolled, to a maximum bonus of +4. The weapon is magical during this time.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #110, Ruby Red Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Whenever you take damage from a spell or a spell-like magical effect while this ruby red lozenge orbits your head, reduce the damage by 1 for each damage die rolled, to a minimum of 1 damage per die.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #111, Deep Blue Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to target one unattended object within 30 feet that weighs no more than 20 pounds. It flies toward your free hand at 10 feet per second. If a creature is holding or wearing the object, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or release it.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #112, Blue Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to displace your image for 1 minute. The first attack roll made against you during this time automatically misses. Thereafter, attack rolls against you have Disadvantage. If you take damage, the Disadvantage is suppressed until the start of your next turn, but the effect otherwise continues.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #113, Red Catseye
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to reveal every secret or concealed door within 30 feet that is within your line of sight. Each such portal is outlined in pale blue light visible only to you for 1 round.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #114, Blue Multi-Faceted Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to accelerate natural healing for 1 hour. At the end of each 10-minute interval you spend resting, you can spend one Hit Die without reducing your available Hit Dice, and you regain one expended Hit Die. This effect doesn't restore feature uses or Spell Slots.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #115, Deep Red Tetragonal
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain Resistance to Bludgeoning damage from melee weapon attacks for 3 rounds. This protection doesn't apply to natural weapons, falling objects, siege weapons, or hurled boulders.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #116, Deep Purple Dodecahedron
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to create an immobile, transparent cylinder of force centered on yourself. It has a 3-foot radius, is 10 feet high, and lasts 1 minute without requiring Concentration. It otherwise functions as {@spell Wall of Force|XPHB}. You can dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #117, Yellow Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to increase your mass to as much as 2,000 pounds for 1 minute without changing your Size. While at maximum mass, your unarmed strike deals {@damage 1d4 + 8} Bludgeoning damage, and your melee weapon attacks deal 6 extra damage on a hit. You have Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws made to resist being moved or knocked Prone, but your Speed is halved and you can't jump.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #118, Orange Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and touch up to 2 connected cubic feet of nonmagical stone. For 1 minute, the stone is as pliable as clay for you. When the effect ends, it hardens permanently in its current shape.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #119, Turquoise Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to emit a flashing strobe in a 30-foot Emanation. Every creature in the area other than you that has eyes and is CR 3 or lower must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|TGTT} condition for 3 rounds. A stunned creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success. The stone doesn't distinguish friend from foe.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #120, Purple Multi-Faceted Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to create a pulsing electrical field for 3 rounds. A creature hostile to you that enters a 5-foot Emanation originating from you for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes {@damage 2d6 + 2} Lightning damage.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #121, Blue Tetragonal
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to fire 4 crystal shards at one creature you can see within 60 feet. Make a separate ranged spell attack for each shard, using your choice of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. Each shard deals {@damage 1d4 + 2} Piercing damage and then crumbles. These attacks ignore AC granted by manufactured armor and shields; against them, the target's AC equals 10 + its Dexterity modifier + any magical AC bonuses not supplied by armor or a shield. Natural Armor functions normally.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #122, Brilliant Green Multi-Faceted Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: At each dawn, roll {@dice 1d6} and {@dice 1d100} to select one of the 600 numbered Ioun Stones. Until the next dawn, the Changeling Stone assumes that stone's appearance and all its properties. If it assumes a stone with charges or limited uses, it has only 1 charge or use. If it becomes {@item Ioun Stone #015, Dull Gray Stone|MECIounStones}, roll {@dice 1d20}; on a 1, the transformation becomes permanent and the Changeling Stone loses this property.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #123, Clear Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. Attacking, dealing damage, or casting a spell doesn't end the condition.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #124, Orange Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: While this orange spindle orbits your head, it and all your other orbiting Ioun Stones are Invisible to every creature other than you. {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB} reveals their presence but not their individual identities or properties.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #125, Green Octahedron
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to AC against attacks made by Celestials, Fiends, and other creatures native to the Outer Planes that are CR 5 or lower. You also gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against their abilities.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #126, Amber Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to see Invisible creatures and objects for 3 rounds, but only within a 60-foot Cone originating from you. The stone reveals every form of invisibility within that Cone.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #127, Green Faceted Lens
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become a silent shadow for 1 minute. While in Dim Light or Darkness, you have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition, make no sound, and can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space in Dim Light or Darkness as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can occupy the space of a creature that casts a shadow and move with it, remaining unnoticed unless it succeeds on a DC 20 Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check. The effect ends early immediately after you make an attack or cast a spell.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #128, Lavender Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to summon a {@creature Shard|MECIounStones} in an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet. The Shard is friendly to you and your allies, obeys your verbal or telepathic commands, and acts immediately after your turn. It vanishes after 1 minute, when reduced to 0 Hit Points, or when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #129, Blue Catseye
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: For every 365 days this blue catseye orbits your head, you age only 1 day. You are immune to magical aging, including aging caused by a creature, spell, Potion of Speed, or similar effect.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #130, Dark Orange Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to become fixed in your current position for 1 minute, even in midair. During this time, you can't be moved against your will, fall, or have the Prone condition, and you can move only by ending the effect as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. The stone can support you and up to 8,000 pounds of worn or carried weight.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #131, Dusty Rose Faceted Lens
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to enter and move through solid stone for 1 minute. You have a Burrow Speed of 30 feet through stone, leave no passage, and can see normally while inside it. You can't pass through wood, metal, or another material. If the effect ends while you are inside stone, you are expelled into the nearest unoccupied space in a random direction and take {@damage 4d10} Force damage.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #132, Pearl Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can cast {@spell Meld into Stone|XPHB} on yourself from the stone, requiring no components. The spell lasts 1 minute.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #133, Blue Faceted Pyramid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: The stone has 3 charges and regains 1 expended charge daily at dawn. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 charge to transform it into a 4-foot crystalline lance for 1 minute. The lance is a +4 magic spear that deals {@damage 2d4 + 4} Piercing damage instead of its normal damage. It has the Thrown property with a normal range of 60 feet and no long range. Attacks with it ignore AC granted by manufactured armor and shields; against the lance, the target's AC equals 10 + its Dexterity modifier + any magical AC bonuses not supplied by armor or a shield. Natural Armor functions normally. If thrown, the lance vanishes after the attack and returns to orbit in its normal form.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #134, Green Smooth Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You can place this torus beside one magic item for 24 hours to designate that item as its ward. If the ward would be destroyed after failing a saving throw while the torus orbits your head, the torus is destroyed instead and the ward immediately repeats the saving throw. On a success, the ward isn't destroyed. The torus can ward only one item at a time.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #135, Green Catseye
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You have Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) checks made to detect a secret or concealed door while this green catseye orbits your head. If another feature already grants you Advantage on the check, you also add 2 to the roll.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #136, Shining Gold Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to ward yourself against Oozes and other amorphous creatures for 1 minute. Such creatures can't willingly move within 5 feet of you and deal no damage to you with attacks or traits that engulf, envelop, pseudopod, or otherwise make physical contact.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #137, Black and White Dodecahedron
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Charge-Holding (C)|MECIounStones|Charge-Holding (C)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This stone has 3 charges. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 charge and touch a creature or nonmagical stone object. A creature must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or be Petrified as by {@spell Flesh to Stone|XPHB}, requiring no Concentration. A Petrified creature you touch is instead restored to flesh and the Petrified condition ends. A stone object of Large Size or smaller can similarly be transformed into inert flesh or restored to stone, at the DM's discretion. At 0 charges, the stone crumbles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #138, Yellow Catseye
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes, provided you remain in contact with stone. During this time, you automatically know your approximate depth below ground and the direction of slopes, and you have Advantage on checks made to detect unstable stonework, stonework traps, sliding or shifting stone, and concealed passages in stone. Each use after the first before the next dawn reduces the Tremorsense range by 5 feet; the stone can't be activated if this would reduce the range to 0. A Dwarf or Gnome also adds 2 to these checks.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: These benefits function continuously while the stone orbits, with no decreasing range. A super-charged stone is very rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #138, Yellow Catseye (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #138, Yellow Catseye (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes, provided you remain in contact with stone. During this time, you automatically know your approximate depth below ground and the direction of slopes, and you have Advantage on checks made to detect unstable stonework, stonework traps, sliding or shifting stone, and concealed passages in stone. Each use after the first before the next dawn reduces the Tremorsense range by 5 feet; the stone can't be activated if this would reduce the range to 0. A Dwarf or Gnome also adds 2 to these checks.
These benefits function continuously while the stone orbits, with no decreasing range.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #138, Yellow Catseye|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #139, Ruby Red Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When this rod first bonds to you, roll four times on the six numbered Ioun Stone tables, rerolling duplicates and #400. Record those four stones. At each dawn, roll randomly among them; until the next dawn, this rod assumes the selected stone's appearance and all its properties. If it assumes a stone with charges or limited uses, it has only 1 charge or use. If it becomes {@item Ioun Stone #015, Dull Gray Stone|MECIounStones}, roll {@dice 1d20}; on a 1, the transformation becomes permanent and the rod loses this property.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: Record six stones rather than four. The rod remains an artifact. See {@item Ioun Stone #139, Ruby Red Rod (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #139, Ruby Red Rod (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When this rod first bonds to you, roll four times on the six numbered Ioun Stone tables, rerolling duplicates and #400. Record those four stones. At each dawn, roll randomly among them; until the next dawn, this rod assumes the selected stone's appearance and all its properties. If it assumes a stone with charges or limited uses, it has only 1 charge or use. If it becomes {@item Ioun Stone #015, Dull Gray Stone|MECIounStones}, roll {@dice 1d20}; on a 1, the transformation becomes permanent and the rod loses this property.
Record six stones rather than four.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #139, Ruby Red Rod|MECIounStones}.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #140, Dusty Rose Faceted Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to shield yourself from extraordinary weapon properties for 1 minute. A weapon can still hit you and deal its normal damage, including its bonus to damage, but it can't impose any additional effect on you, such as severing a limb, reducing your Hit Point maximum, dealing ongoing damage, or killing you outright on a particular attack roll.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #141, Indigo Blue Faceted Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Charge-Holding (C)|MECIounStones|Charge-Holding (C)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This torus has 3 charges. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 charge and target a Medium or smaller creature within 30 feet. The target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition for 3 rounds. On a successful save, it has the {@condition Stunned|TGTT} condition until the end of its next turn. At 0 charges, the torus crumbles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #142, Clear Connected Spheres
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to become ghost-like for 3 rounds. You have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, your Speed is 0, and you are immune to all damage except Force and damage dealt by a creature or weapon on the Ethereal Plane.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #143, Cobalt Blue Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Charge-Holding (C)|MECIounStones|Charge-Holding (C)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This cylinder has 2 charges. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 charge and target a 5-foot Cube of nonmagical earth or stone within 20 feet. At the end of your next turn, the target disintegrates into harmless dust. Metal and creatures are unaffected. At 0 charges, the cylinder crumbles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #144, Black Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target one magic item you can see within 60 feet. If the item is worn or carried, its bearer can make a DC 20 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, or if the item is unattended, the item's magical properties are suppressed for 3 rounds. An artifact is immune.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #145, Deep Purple Multi-Faceted Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When this cylinder first bonds to you, it gains 3 charges. Each expended charge returns 7 days after it was expended. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 charge to teleport yourself and your worn and carried equipment to a point you can see clearly, no matter how far away it is. You must be able to distinguish details at the destination. You can expend additional charges on later turns to continue traveling by successive lines of sight.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #146, Pearl White Faceted Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and link yourself to one creature within 20 feet for 1 minute. An unwilling creature can make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw to prevent the link. Whenever you would take damage while linked, the other creature takes that damage instead. The link ends early if you and the creature are ever more than 60 feet apart or on different planes.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #147, Purple and Lavender Multi-Faceted Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When found, this cylinder can absorb 22 spell levels. When a level 9 spell would affect you, the stone absorbs the spell without requiring an action, and the spell has no effect on you. If you are the spell's only target, the spell is canceled. The stone loses 9 charges. If it has fewer than 9 charges, it has no effect on that spell. At 0 charges, it becomes {@item Ioun Stone #015, Dull Gray Stone|MECIounStones|a dull gray stone}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #148, Turquoise Tetragonal
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to delay physical exhaustion for 8 hours. During this time, you can travel, run, swim, climb, or perform similar exertion for twice as long before the DM calls for a Constitution check or imposes Exhaustion, and you have Advantage on such checks.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: You can exert yourself for three times as long. A super-charged stone is rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #148, Turquoise Tetragonal (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #148, Turquoise Tetragonal (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to delay physical exhaustion for 8 hours. During this time, you can travel, run, swim, climb, or perform similar exertion for twice as long before the DM calls for a Constitution check or imposes Exhaustion, and you have Advantage on such checks.
You can exert yourself for three times as long.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #148, Turquoise Tetragonal|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #149, Emerald Green Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to emit an ultrasonic pulse in a 30-foot Cone. Nonmagical glass and crystal objects in the Cone shatter. A magic glass or crystal object must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or shatter. An object worn or carried by a creature uses the creature's saving throw. Ioun Stones are immune.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #150, Maroon Smooth Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, when you cast a spell of level 1-3 using a Spell Slot, you can cause the stone to duplicate its magical pattern. Before the end of your next turn, you can cast the same spell again without expending a Spell Slot or providing Material components. If you don't, the duplicated pattern is lost.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The stone can duplicate a spell of level 1-5. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #150, Maroon Smooth Egg (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #150, Maroon Smooth Egg (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

Before the end of your next turn, you can cast the same spell again without expending a Spell Slot or providing Material components. If you don't, the duplicated pattern is lost.
The stone can duplicate a spell of level 1-5.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #150, Maroon Smooth Egg|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #151, Flickering Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When you cast a spell using a Spell Slot, you can activate this prism without an action. Treat the spell as though it were cast with a spell slot 3 levels higher, to a maximum of level 9. Every damage or healing die of the spell uses its highest result instead of being rolled, and targets take a -2 penalty to saving throws against it. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #152, Pale Blue Multi-Faceted Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create two linked portals, one in your space and one at a point you can see within 100 feet. Each portal is just large enough for you, and only you and your worn and carried equipment can pass through them. They remain for 1 minute, allowing travel in either direction.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #153, Bright Green Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: While this bright green prism orbits your head, you and your worn or carried items ignore planar traits that would suppress, alter, or destroy magic or matter brought from another plane. You can breathe, move, perceive, and survive the ambient physical conditions of any plane, but the stone doesn't protect you from creatures, attacks, or localized hazards.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #154, Amber Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to transform your skin for 1 minute. Roll {@dice 1d100} to determine the form. Whenever you take damage from an attack, reduce the damage by the listed amount, to a minimum of 0.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #155, Green Faceted Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to AC against attacks made by creatures native to the Inner Planes, including Elementals and creatures native to the Ethereal Plane. You also gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against their abilities.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #156, Bright White Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become infused with positive energy for 1 minute. Calculate the greatest Hit Point maximum you could have at your current level by treating every Hit Point Die gained from a class as though it had rolled its highest number and applying your current Constitution modifier. Your Hit Point maximum becomes that number for the duration, and your current Hit Points increase by the same amount. When the effect ends, your maximum and current Hit Points return to their previous values, less any damage taken during the effect.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: Your temporary Hit Point maximum is 150 percent of the calculated maximum, rounded down. The stone remains an artifact. See {@item Ioun Stone #156, Bright White Sphere (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #156, Bright White Sphere (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become infused with positive energy for 1 minute. Calculate the greatest Hit Point maximum you could have at your current level by treating every Hit Point Die gained from a class as though it had rolled its highest number and applying your current Constitution modifier. Your Hit Point maximum becomes that number for the duration, and your current Hit Points increase by the same amount. When the effect ends, your maximum and current Hit Points return to their previous values, less any damage taken during the effect.
Your temporary Hit Point maximum is 150 percent of the calculated maximum, rounded down.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #156, Bright White Sphere|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #157, Lime Green Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to make your voice and thoughts boom from the heavens for 1 minute. When you activate the stone and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on later turns, you can issue a one-word command to each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation. A target must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or obey the command on its next turn, as with {@spell Command|XPHB}. Your voice is audible out to 300 feet during the effect.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #158, Clear Smooth Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to solidify each footprint you make on water or another noncorrosive liquid for 1 hour. Each 1-foot patch remains solid and fixed for 1 round, even in a current. You cross these patches safely. Another creature following your path must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check for each turn it moves across them or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #159, Clear Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to release elemental wind in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be pushed 40 feet directly away from you and have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #160, Pearl Brown Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to release elemental gravel in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d10 + 2} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #161, Deep Red Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to release elemental fire in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 4d6} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #162, Cobalt Blue Smooth Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to release elemental water in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a DC 18 Strength saving throw, taking {@damage 2d6 + 2} Bludgeoning damage and being pushed {@dice 2d6 * 10} feet directly away from you on a failed save. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #163, Lavender Twisted Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to empower the stone for 1 minute. When a damaging spell targets only you during this time, the spell instead targets its caster, using the caster's original spell attack modifier and save DC. This property doesn't reflect an area spell unless you were its initial target, as with some lines of lightning.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #164, Pale Lavender Snowflake
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can cast one spell of level 3 or lower that you have prepared or know without expending a Spell Slot. The stone supplies every component that lacks a listed cost. Because the spell uses energy stored entirely within the stone, you can cast it in an Antimagic Field or similar area, and that field doesn't suppress the spell.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The stone can power a spell of level 5 or lower. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #164, Pale Lavender Snowflake (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #164, Pale Lavender Snowflake (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

The stone can power a spell of level 5 or lower.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #164, Pale Lavender Snowflake|MECIounStones}.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #165, Maroon Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to learn the direction and approximate distance to the nearest Zaeranni site on your plane. Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to activate a Zaeranni Gate Obelisk and open its link to the single destination encoded in that obelisk. The stone doesn't allow you to select or navigate to another destination. In a campaign without Zaeranni sites, the DM should replace this result.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #166, Incandescent Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to cover yourself in crystalline armor for 1 minute. You gain a +2 bonus to AC, your Strength increases by 2 to a maximum of 24, your Speed increases by 10 feet, and the armor absorbs the first 5 damage you take during each round. When the effect ends, the armor crumbles into powder. After each use, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #167, Emerald Green Faceted Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: While this emerald green faceted egg orbits your head, you can't be targeted by Divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors, telepathy, Clairvoyance, Clairaudience, or similar remote senses.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #168, Silvery Mirrored Dodecahedron
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to surround yourself with shifting panes of force for 1 minute. You gain a +2 bonus to AC. A hostile creature that enters a 5-foot Emanation originating from you for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes {@damage 3d4} Force damage.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #169, Turquoise Faceted Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can touch a nonliving object and teleport it. An object weighing 2 pounds or less appears at a point you can see within 60 feet. An object weighing more than 2 pounds but no more than 10 pounds instead appears {@dice 1d4 * 10} feet away in a random direction. An object worn or carried by another creature is unaffected.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #170, Pale Lavender Twisted Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can project a forge-hot ray capable of melting and working any metal, mithral, or dragon hide. For each round you sustain it, your Constitution score is reduced by 1. If this would reduce your Constitution to 5 or lower, you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. You recover 1 lost Constitution after each Long Rest. Each round spent using the ray adds 3 percentage points to a percentile magic-item creation roll, or +1 to a 5e crafting check for every 2 rounds, at the DM's discretion.

entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target a spellcaster within 30 feet. entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to telekinetically manipulate objects for 1 minute. On each of your turns, you can move one unsecured object you can see within 60 feet up to 30 feet. Its maximum weight is 20 pounds × your Intelligence score, plus 30 pounds for each point of Intelligence above 18. An object held by another creature requires you to win an Intelligence contest against its Strength.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When this sphere is first found, roll {@dice 1d8} for an Arcane spell or {@dice 1d6} for a Divine spell to determine the maximum level it can hold. A spellcaster can cast one eligible spell into the stone, permanently fixing that spell as its property. Five percent of these stones are found with a spell already fixed within them.

While the sphere orbits your head, you can cast its fixed spell without a Spell Slot or Material components. A level 1-5 spell can be cast once per day, and a level 6-8 spell can be cast once every 7 days. It is cast at the highest level the sphere can hold. The stone's rarity is uncommon for level 1-2, rare for level 3, very rare for level 4-5, legendary for level 6-7, and artifact for level 8.

It makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d6 + 2} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A flammable target that fails also takes {@damage 2d6} Fire damage at the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The initial damage is {@damage 4d6 + 3}, and the save DC is 18. A super-charged stone is very rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #237, Ruby Red Prism (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target a creature within 30 feet. It makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d6 + 2} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. item.name: Ioun Stone #238, Pale Blue Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can make a 1-foot crystal cube appear in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. Each face is an opening into an extradimensional storage space. Any number of unattended objects that fit through a 1-foot-square opening can be stored, and you can retrieve a specific stored object as a Utilize action. The cube vanishes when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} or when the stone ceases to orbit, but its contents remain stored. If the stone is destroyed, every stored object is lost on the Elemental Plane of Earth.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #239, Lime Green Faceted Lens
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and roll {@dice 1d20} to create a reflective field for 1 minute. Whenever a melee attack deals damage to you, reduce that damage by the amount shown and deal the same amount of Force damage to the attacker.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #240, Bright Blue Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Water you drink while this ellipsoid orbits is purified of poison, disease, salt, and other contamination. Other ingested poisons are likewise rendered harmless and become pleasant-tasting fluid. Once per day, when you drink a potion, you can cause every variable numerical effect and duration of the potion to use its highest possible result.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #241, Bright Silver Faceted Lens
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: These stones are always found as a linked pair and must bond to two different creatures. Once per day, either bonded creature can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the other stone, provided both stones are within 100 feet and their bonded creatures can see each other.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #242, Red Smooth Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, when a spell targets only you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and make a saving throw using your highest mental ability against the caster's Spell Save DC. On a failure, the spell affects you normally. On a success, the caster makes the same saving throw against its own Spell Save DC. On its failure, the spell targets the caster instead; on its success, the spell vanishes with no effect. Area spells are unaffected.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #243, Lavender and Green Star
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, when you cast a spell, you can halve its casting time. A casting time of 1 action becomes a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}; a casting time measured in rounds, minutes, or hours is halved, rounding up.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: You can use this property twice per day. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #243, Lavender and Green Star (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #243, Lavender and Green Star (Super-Charged)
