entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, when you cast a spell, you can halve its casting time. A casting time of 1 action becomes a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}; a casting time measured in rounds, minutes, or hours is halved, rounding up.
You can use this property twice per day.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #243, Lavender and Green Star|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #244, Cobalt Blue Faceted Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create a 1-inch-thick crystal rope up to 60 feet long for 1 minute. It can support 1,000 pounds and fixes itself immovably to a point or surface you choose. It has AC 20, 30 Hit Points, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. It crumbles when the duration ends.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #245, Glowing Rose Star
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: If this star orbits beside a burned-out {@item Ioun Stone #015, Dull Gray Stone|MECIounStones} for 7 consecutive days, it transfers its energy and restores the burned-out stone's original color, shape, and properties. Cracks and other physical damage are repaired. A restored stone that normally has charges returns with 1 charge. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. This star crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #246, Green Faceted Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to open a brief conduit to the Elemental Plane of Water and create up to 100 gallons of fresh, clean water in containers or open spaces you can see within 30 feet. The water is permanent.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #247, Smooth Pale Lavender Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create a crystalline duplicate of yourself for 1 minute. It appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet, has AC 10, 10 Hit Points, your Speed and ability scores, and acts immediately after your turn. You control it mentally, and it can move and take the Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Search, Study, or Utilize action, but it can't attack, cast spells, or activate magic items. It crumbles at 0 Hit Points.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #248, White Faceted Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become immune to the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} and {@condition Petrified|XPHB} conditions imposed by touch-range attacks, spells, and abilities for 1 minute.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #249, Silvery Mirrored Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and send the helix against a creature within 30 feet. For 3 rounds, immediately after your turn, the helix makes a melee spell attack against the target using your Proficiency Bonus and highest mental ability modifier. On a hit, it deals {@damage 2d4 + 4} Force damage. It then returns to orbit.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #250, Clear Smooth Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can lower the temperature in a 10-foot Emanation by 20 degrees Fahrenheit, to a minimum of 32 degrees, or lower the temperature of up to 10 gallons of liquid by 30 degrees. The effect lasts 1 hour and moves with you if you chose the Emanation.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #251, Pearl White Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: These rods are always found as a linked pair and must bond to two different creatures. Once per day, either bonded creature can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to activate the pair for 1 minute. While the two stones are within 60 feet and their bonded creatures can see each other, either creature can cast spells as though it occupied the other's space.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #252, Clear Faceted Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, when you cast a spell that deals Hit Point damage, you can roll {@dice 1d20} and apply the following effect.

entries.caption: Unstable Flux
rows: The spell backfires. Roll {@dice 1d100}. On 01-85, the spell fails and its resources are wasted. On 86-100, the spell takes effect with you as its point of origin or target.
Treat the spell as cast with a Spell Slot 1 level higher, to a maximum of level 9.
Treat the spell as cast with a Spell Slot 2 levels higher, to a maximum of level 9.
Treat the spell as cast with a Spell Slot 3 levels higher, to a maximum of level 9.
Every damage die uses its highest result instead of being rolled.
Roll the spell's damage normally, then double the total.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #253, Deep Purple Catseye
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to create a vacuum in a 10-foot Emanation for 1 minute. Sound can't be created in or pass through the area, open flames are extinguished, and creatures other than you can't breathe there. A bubble of fresh air surrounds you.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #254, Deep Red Faceted Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}. {@i The source's quick-reference table lists this stone as V/L.}

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You have Darkvision out to 120 feet while this deep red faceted helix orbits your head, and your Darkvision doesn't reduce colors to shades of gray. If you already have Darkvision of at least 60 feet, its range instead doubles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #255, Pale Yellow Faceted Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become amorphous for 1 minute. You and your equipment can pass through openings as narrow as 1/2 inch, your Speed is 10 feet, and you have Resistance to Slashing damage. You retain no special attacks of an Ooze.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #256, Lavender Catseye
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to shift yourself and your worn and carried equipment to the Quasi-Elemental Plane of Mineral for {@dice 2d6 + 2} × 10 minutes. The stone protects you from the plane's ambient conditions and allows simple telepathic communication with its intelligent inhabitants, whose initial attitude toward you is Friendly. When the duration ends, you return to the space you left or the nearest unoccupied space.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #257, Deep Black Smooth Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to perceive magical auras for 1 minute, either in a 30-foot Emanation or around one creature within 60 feet. You perceive Invisible creatures and objects and identify the presence of protective spells, Globes of Invulnerability, antimagic, and magical barriers, though not their exact properties.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #258, Vibrant Purple Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to flash-freeze a 20-foot Emanation. The air becomes 32 degrees Fahrenheit, exposed water freezes to a depth of 6 feet, and every surface is covered in ice. Brown Mold in the area is destroyed. The temperature and ice return to normal over 1 hour, even in extreme heat.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #259, Yellow Smooth Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, when you are reduced to 0 Hit Points by ongoing bleeding or another effect that doesn't kill you outright, the stone immediately restores you to 1 Hit Point. It can't save you from damage that equals or exceeds your Hit Point maximum after reducing you to 0. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #260, Pale Blue Smooth Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to make up to 100 pounds of metal as soft and pliable as thick taffy for 1 minute. A creature manipulating the metal has Advantage and a +4 bonus on Strength checks made to bend, break, or reshape it. Magic metal is unaffected unless its bearer fails a DC 18 Charisma saving throw.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #261, Blue Smooth Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: These helices are always found as a linked pair and must bond to two different creatures. Once per day, either creature can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to establish two-way telepathic communication between them for 1 minute, provided both are on the same plane of existence.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #262, Bright Rose Smooth Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to increase or reduce your height and dimensions by up to 25 percent for 1 minute. Your weight changes proportionally, but your Size category and game statistics don't change.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: You can alter your dimensions by up to 50 percent. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #262, Bright Rose Smooth Torus (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #262, Bright Rose Smooth Torus (Super-Charged)

_copy.name: Ioun Stone #262, Bright Rose Smooth Torus

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to increase or reduce your height and dimensions by up to 25 percent for 1 minute. Your weight changes proportionally, but your Size category and game statistics don't change.
You can alter your dimensions by up to 50 percent.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #262, Bright Rose Smooth Torus|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #263, Green Smooth Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target a creature within 30 feet. You immediately sense its dominant emotions. It must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or you can replace one emotion with another of your choice, such as turning hatred into indifference or fear into trust, for 1 hour. This doesn't control the creature's actions.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #264, Yellow Smooth Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can spend 1 round mentally walking 3 rounds into one probable future. Describe the course of action you intend to take. The DM describes what your projected self most likely experiences during that time, including visible consequences and immediate reactions. You then return to the present without time having passed and can choose a different course.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #265, Rainbow Dodecahedron
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to orient your personal gravity toward any solid surface for 1 minute. You can walk on walls and ceilings, and you fall toward your chosen surface. Your Speed is halved during the effect.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #266, Dark Green Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can touch two nonliving objects of similar material for 1 round to fuse them seamlessly for 1 minute, mending a break or sealing an opening. If either object is worn or carried by an unwilling creature, that creature can make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw to prevent the fusion.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #267, Dark Orange Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and choose one spell or magical effect within 20 feet. Roll {@dice 1d100} to determine the stone's fixed chance to dispel it. A permanent effect is suppressed for 1 minute instead of ending.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #268, Pale Green Faceted Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain a warrior's accuracy for 1 minute. If you have no levels in Barbarian, Fighter, Paladin, or Ranger, add your Proficiency Bonus a second time to your weapon attack rolls. If you have a level in one of those classes, you instead gain a +1 bonus to weapon attack rolls, and the duration is 1 minute.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #269, Clear Faceted Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to activate a Zaeranni Gate Obelisk. Unlike {@item Ioun Stone #165, Maroon Cube|MECIounStones}, this stone lets you navigate the Portal of Worlds network and choose any destination whose route you know. In a campaign without Zaeranni sites, the DM should replace this result.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #270, Bright Green Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to mute a 20-foot Emanation for 1 minute. A sound created in the area is reduced to a whisper and can't be heard more than 10 feet beyond its source. Verbal spell components can still be spoken.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #271, Pearl White Teardrop
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: These teardrops are always found as a linked pair and must bond to two different creatures. Once per day, while the creatures are within 60 feet and can see each other, either can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to exchange their nonmagical melee attack bonuses for 1 minute. Each uses the other's ability modifier and Proficiency Bonus for melee attack rolls, but no magic-item bonuses are transferred.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #272, Marbled Blue and White Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to transform the stone into a 3-foot crystal disc for 1 minute. While standing on it, you have a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover; the disc supports you and up to 200 pounds of additional equipment. When you take damage, you must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or fall from the disc.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to coat one handheld weapon in force for 1 minute. On a hit, it deals 6 extra Force damage.

item.name: Ioun Stone #274, Steel Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to influence Beasts with a combined CR of 8 or lower that you can see within 60 feet for 1 minute. A Beast with Intelligence 4 or higher can make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw to resist. An affected Beast obeys your telepathic commands but won't take an action that it knows will directly harm it.

item.name: Ioun Stone #275, Clear Smooth Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can concentrate for 3 rounds while touching up to 1 pound of solid, nonmagical material. At the end, it permanently becomes 1/2 pound of another nonmagical material you have touched while bonded to this stone. The new material can be valuable, including gold or diamond.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #276, Cerulean Blue Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to accelerate all plant growth in a 30-foot Emanation for 1 minute. Each round produces one month of natural growth. The growth is permanent and can make the area Difficult Terrain at the DM's discretion.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: Each round produces one year of natural growth. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #276, Cerulean Blue Rectangle (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

Each round produces one year of natural growth.

item.name: Ioun Stone #277, Lavender and Green Faceted Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, this egg accumulates one charge of Positive Energy. You can touch it to a magic Rod, Staff, Wand, or Ioun Stone to transfer the charge. The target must have at least 1 charge or available use and can't be raised above 4 charges or uses by this property. The recharged property must duplicate a spell of level 4 or lower or be of comparable power, as determined by the DM. Transferring the charge can let another Ioun Stone recharge sooner than normal.

entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws against an Undead creature's touch-range attacks and abilities, including effects that impose Paralysis, disease, or reduction of Hit Point maximum.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The bonus is +2 instead. A super-charged stone is very rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #278, Pearl White Smooth Torus (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #279, Sky Blue Dodecahedron

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When found, this dodecahedron can absorb 26 enhancement points. When a magic weapon hits you, its normal weapon and ability-modifier damage applies, but its magical bonus to damage and every additional magical property of the hit are negated. The stone expends enhancement points equal to the weapon's magical bonus, or 1 point if it has no numerical bonus. If too few points remain, the magic isn't negated. At 0 points, it becomes {@item Ioun Stone #015, Dull Gray Stone|MECIounStones}.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #280, Yellow Faceted Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your positive Constitution modifier × your level. They last 1 minute. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #281, Orange Faceted Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: These tori are always found as a linked pair and must bond to two different creatures. Once every 7 days, either creature can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the other stone, with no chance of error, provided both stones are on the same plane of existence.

entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with every weapon and unarmed strike and a +1 bonus to damage rolls with melee weapons and unarmed strikes. The damage bonus doesn't apply to ranged attacks.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The bonuses are +2 instead. A super-charged stone is very rare. See {@item Ioun Stone #282, Pale Aquamarine Lozenge (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #283, Deep Black Faceted Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: At each dawn, you can designate one weapon that has the Thrown property. Whenever you throw that weapon while the torus orbits your head, it flies back to your hand immediately after the attack.

item.name: Ioun Stone #284, Purple and White Connected Spheres
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to loosen the molecules of up to 10 feet of connected stone for 1 minute, creating a passage 3 feet wide and 5 feet high. The stone becomes solid when the effect ends; a creature inside is shunted to the nearest opening and takes {@damage 4d10} Force damage.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The passage can cross 20 feet of stone or 6 inches of metal. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #284, Purple and White Connected Spheres (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to freeze up to a 10-foot Cube of solid mineral in place for 1 minute. A falling block, collapsing ceiling, crumbling floor, or similar mineral structure in the area becomes immovable and indestructible for the duration. You choose whether the area remains fixed or moves with you. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #286, Dusty Rose Faceted Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become imperceptible to Undead for 1 minute. Undead can't perceive, target, or react to you. The effect ends immediately after you attack, deal damage, cast a spell that affects an Undead, or use a feature that censures Undead. While protected, you can't affect an Undead in any way.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #287, White and Pink Snowflake
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to turn the ground in a 10-foot Emanation into an adhesive tar for 1 minute. You move through it normally. Another creature in the area has a Speed of 0 and must succeed on a DC 18 Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check as an action to move up to half its Speed that turn.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #288, Faceted Lavender Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When found, this torus can absorb 55 damage. Damage you would take from a weapon attack or a creature's nonmagical natural weapon is deducted from this reserve instead. Any excess damage affects you normally. Damage from spells, breath weapons, and other magical effects is unaffected. At 0 reserve, the torus crumbles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #289, White Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to transform the stone into a razor-edged crystal disc and hurl it at a creature within 30 feet. Make a ranged attack using only your Proficiency Bonus, with no ability modifier. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d4 + 4} Slashing damage. If the d20 roll is 18 or 19 and the attack hits, the disc also severs one of the target's limbs, chosen by the DM. On a natural 20, it instead severs the target's head as a {@item Vorpal Sword|XDMG}; a creature that can't be decapitated takes an extra {@damage 6d8} Slashing damage. The disc then returns to orbit. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #290, Glowing Rose Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When a spell of level 4 or lower targets only you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to absorb it. The spell has no effect and is stored in the spindle. You can later cast the stored spell using the original caster's spell attack modifier and Spell Save DC. If the spell isn't on your class spell list or is of a level you couldn't normally cast, its targets gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against it. After you cast the stored spell, the spindle can't absorb another for 7 days.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The spindle can absorb a spell of level 6 or lower. A super-charged stone is an artifact. See {@item Ioun Stone #290, Glowing Rose Spindle (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When a spell of level 4 or lower targets only you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to absorb it. The spell has no effect and is stored in the spindle. You can later cast the stored spell using the original caster's spell attack modifier and Spell Save DC. If the spell isn't on your class spell list or is of a level you couldn't normally cast, its targets gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against it. After you cast the stored spell, the spindle can't absorb another for 7 days.
The spindle can absorb a spell of level 6 or lower.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #290, Glowing Rose Spindle|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: These helices are always found as a linked pair and must bond to two different creatures. Once per day, when one bonded creature drinks a potion usable by both, it can share the effect with the other creature if both are on the same plane. Divide a randomly determined duration equally between them, rounding down. Potions affecting the pair never trigger potion-miscibility mishaps with one another.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You are immune to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition, magical commands and compulsions, and every form of short-term, long-term, or indefinite madness while this bright blue octahedron orbits your head.

entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to fill a 5-foot Emanation with thick rainbow vapor for 1 minute. Attack rolls against you take a -2 penalty.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to summon a 1-foot crystalline likeness of yourself for 1 minute. It has AC 20, {@dice 2d8 + 2} Hit Points, Speed 30 feet, and your saving throws. It acts immediately after your turn, obeys simple commands, and makes two melee attacks each turn using your spell attack modifier; each hit deals {@damage 1d4} Force damage. It vanishes at 0 Hit Points.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #295, Blue Faceted Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Choose Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma when this torus bonds to you. The chosen score increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while it orbits your head. You can change the chosen score after the torus has remained out of orbit for 24 hours.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The chosen score increases by 4, still to a maximum of 20. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #295, Blue Faceted Torus (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries: The damage is {@damage 6d4 + 6}, and the save DC is 20. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #296, Blue Rod (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

This roll is made before any saving throw. At level 34 or higher, you are therefore immune to such effects while the stone orbits.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This object is two Ioun Stones fused together during formation. Roll twice on the six numbered Ioun Stone tables, rerolling #300; the fused stone has the full properties of both results simultaneously. Five percent of fused stones contain three stones instead, requiring three rolls. Because of its size, a fused stone can't be placed in an Ioun Halo, Ioun Ring, Ioun Armband, or similar Ioun-sand matrix.

Each takes {@damage 2d4} Necrotic damage, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the total damage dealt for 1 minute. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to turn the cube Invisible and send it toward a creature within 30 feet. Randomly choose one of that creature's orbiting Ioun Stones. The bonded creature must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or the target stone begins orbiting this cube, which immediately returns to you. The captured stone confers no benefit until it completes a new 7-day Ioun bond with you.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can spend 1 minute touching nonmagical gemstones or metal worth no more than 1,000 gp. The material permanently transforms into an equal value of another gemstone or metal, combining or dividing into pieces as you choose.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can concentrate for 1 round. There is a {@chance 50|50 percent|Detect Harm} chance you sense every hostile or harmful magical effect within 20 feet, including Charms, Illusions, curses, and magical surveillance, and learn its direction. On a 1, the stone detects nothing.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When you make an attack roll for or roll damage with a Fire spell, you can lose Hit Points in multiples of 5, with no action required. For every 5 Hit Points lost, gain a +1 bonus to the spell's attack rolls and add 1 to each damage die. This loss can't be reduced or redirected. After each use, roll {@dice 1d4}; on a 1, the stone crumbles.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You can communicate basic concepts and emotions with any living creature that has Intelligence 1 or higher while this deep blue cube orbits your head, even if it has no language. You can convey only simple ideas such as danger, food, friend, follow, stop, or pain.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, choose a creature within 30 feet. The stone creates 8 missiles, each dealing {@damage 1d4 + 1} Force damage to the target. If you can't cast Wizard spells, make a ranged spell attack using your highest mental ability; on a miss, every missile is lost. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, at the end of your turn, you can immediately take 4 additional turns, one after another. On each additional turn, you can move normally and take one action, one {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, and one {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}. If you take the Attack action, you can make only one weapon attack regardless of Extra Attack or similar features. You can cast no more than one spell on each additional turn. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, choose one ability score, and roll {@dice 1d10}. The modification lasts {@dice 1d4 + 2} × 10 minutes.

rows: The chosen score decreases by 2, to a minimum of 1.
The chosen score increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.
The chosen score increases by 4, to a maximum of 20.
The chosen score increases by 4, with no maximum.

Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to teleport yourself and everything you wear or carry to the designated location, provided it is on the same plane. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and choose a nonmagical rock or section of stone weighing up to 10 pounds within 30 feet. It explodes. When the cocoon shatters, you remain at 0 Hit Points and begin making Death Saving Throws normally.

entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to link yourself to a willing creature within 30 feet for 1 minute. Whenever a melee or ranged weapon attack damages you, the linked creature takes half the damage, rounded down, and you take the remainder. Paralysis, poison, and other additional effects aren't transferred. Either creature can end the link at any time without an action.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to empower the stone for 1 minute. Whenever a spell restores Hit Points to you during this time, add 1 to each healing die. This doesn't affect a potion or a spell cast by a magic item other than a Spell Scroll.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries.name: Stone Effect

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries: This stone contains the memories and personality of one or more former bonded creatures. After your Ioun bond has lasted 7 days, you can communicate with those personalities mentally and consult their memories and expertise. The DM creates each personality and determines its knowledge. Roll {@dice 1d20} when the stone is found to determine the principal personality.

rows: Specialist, such as an alchemist, sage, scribe, or smith
Monster, such as a Troll, Ogre, or Giant
Planar creature, such as a Fiend, Githyanki, or Elemental

entries: Once per day, when you cast a beneficial spell of level 2 or lower targeting only yourself, the stone duplicates its pattern. Before the end of your next turn, you can cast the same spell on another eligible creature without expending a Spell Slot. If you don't, the pattern is lost. Offensive spells can't be doubled.

The spell uses the original casting's statistics and requires no components when released. If unreleased, it vanishes after 24 hours.

The stone can contain only one object.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can activate a Wand, Staff, Rod, or other command-word item without speaking its command word, provided you know it. Alternatively, you can cast one prepared spell without its Verbal component.

item.name: Ioun Stone #375, Ochre Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to determine whether one object or creature you can see within 30 feet is cursed. If it is, roll {@dice 1d100}; on 30 or lower, you learn the curse's effects. A flawed Ioun Stone is detected only on 10 or lower.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #376, Pearl Brown Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You identify any naturally occurring mineral, metal, or gemstone by touch while this pearl brown rod orbits your head, including its common properties and approximate purity.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #377, Pearl White Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When the stone first bonds to you, roll {@dice 1d20} to determine its property. Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to empower it for 1 minute and apply that property to one spell cast during the duration.

entries.caption: Magical Power
rows: The spell requires no Verbal component.
The spell requires no Somatic component.
The spell requires no Verbal or Somatic component.
The spell requires no Verbal, Somatic, or Material component unless the Material component has a listed cost or is consumed.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #378, Pink Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to charge your touch for 1 minute. Whenever you hit a living creature with an unarmed strike or melee spell attack during this time, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition for 3 rounds. Undead are immune.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #379, Cobalt Blue Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and roll {@dice 1d20}, adding 2 if you have a Cleric or Paladin level. In a 20-foot Emanation, each Undead of the rolled kind or a kind listed above it takes {@damage 2d4} Radiant damage. It takes 1 extra damage for each row it is below the rolled result. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #380, Yellow Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can spend 1 hour attempting to reconstruct one broken magic item. Roll {@dice 1d100}; the base success chance is 10 percent + 3 percent per your level + 2 percent per numerical magical bonus the item possessed. The DM decides whether reconstruction is possible. Only one attempt can ever be made on an item. You sense a magic item's condition while holding it. A flawed Ioun Stone can instead be repaired on a flat 10 percent roll.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #381, Sky Blue Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to suppress Darkvision and similar nonnormal vision in a 30-foot Emanation for 1 minute. Truesight is unaffected.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #382, Pulsing White Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain Blindsight with a range of 60 feet for 1 minute. The sense relies on sound and doesn't function while you have the Deafened condition or in an area of magical Silence.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #383, Clear Star
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and roll {@dice 1d20}. The indicated Elemental appears in 3 rounds in an unoccupied space within 30 feet, is friendly to you, communicates with you telepathically, and serves for 1 minute before returning to its home plane.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #384, Blood Red Faceted Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become immune to every special effect of an Undead creature's attack for 1 minute, including Paralysis, disease, possession, and reduction of Hit Point maximum. You still take the attack's Hit Point damage.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #385, Deep Red Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can touch one nonliving object weighing no more than 2,000 pounds and teleport it to an unoccupied space you can see within 100 feet.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: You can instead teleport one willing living creature and everything it wears or carries, subject to the same weight and distance limits. A super-charged stone is an artifact. See {@item Ioun Stone #385, Deep Red Lozenge (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

item.name: Ioun Stone #386, Gold Catseye
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You can attune this stone to a place by spending 24 hours there. If you die while it orbits your head, it immediately teleports your remains and equipment to the attuned place and returns you to life with 1 Hit Point, as if by {@spell Raise Dead|XPHB} but without a time limit or components. Then roll {@dice 1d100}; the stone crumbles on 75 or lower, increasing by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #387, Emerald Green Faceted Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to AC against attacks made by Celestials, Fiends, and other creatures native to the Outer Planes, and a +2 bonus to saving throws against their abilities. A hostile such creature of CR 10 or lower can't willingly move within 5 feet of you unless it first succeeds on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #388, Pale Yellow Faceted Pyramid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you emit prismatic rays in a 15-foot Cone. Two rays strike each creature in the Cone. For each ray, roll {@dice 1d100}, rerolling 11-14 and 21-24. The creature makes a separate DC 20 Dexterity saving throw against each ray, avoiding that ray on a success. After this property resolves, the stone crumbles.

entries.caption: Prismatic Rays
rows: Red. The target takes {@damage 1d10} Fire damage.
Orange. The target is shackled to the ground and has the {@condition Restrained|TGTT} condition until the end of its next turn.
Yellow. An Undead takes {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage. Another creature has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition for 3 rounds.
Green. The target takes {@damage 2d4} Acid damage.
Blue. The target takes {@damage 2d4} Cold damage.
Indigo. Every magic item the target wears or carries is suppressed for 3 rounds.
Violet. The target loses Magic Resistance and similar Advantage on saves against magic and takes a -2 penalty to spell saving throws for 1 minute.
White. A living target regains {@dice 2d4} Hit Points; an Undead takes the same amount of Radiant damage.
Black. The target takes {@damage 2d4} Necrotic damage.
Rainbow. You choose any other ray.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #389, Dark Blue Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and roll {@dice 1d20 * 2} to create an Emanation with that radius in feet for 3 rounds. Area spells and magical effects can't enter or function in the Emanation, though targeted spells and existing magic items function normally. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #390, Pink Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to empower the stone for 1 minute. A Contact Other Plane, Commune, or similar spell you cast during this time allows two additional questions, and every answer can contain up to three words.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create one solid illusory creature of Medium Size or smaller for 1 minute. Choose a Beast of CR 5 or lower whose form you know; the illusion uses that stat block, is friendly to you, obeys your commands, and is real for the duration.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #392, Ruby Red Star
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can handle an object for 10 minutes to read its latent psychic impressions. The DM shows you brief visions involving previous owners and events connected to the place where the object was found.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect

An artifact is immune unless the DM decides otherwise. Then roll again; the stone crumbles on 50 or lower, increasing by 10 for each previous use.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #394, Dusty Rose Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become two-dimensional for 1 minute. Your depth is negligible, allowing you and your equipment to pass through cracks and gaps as narrow as a sheet of paper. You can't end your turn inside a solid object.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #395, Blood Red Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can target a Medium or smaller creature within 60 feet. It must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or be compressed to a molecule-sized point and utterly destroyed, leaving no remains. Only {@spell Wish|XPHB}, divine intervention, or comparable magic can restore it. The stone then crumbles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #396, Lime Green Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to cover a 20-foot-diameter circle of ground within 30 feet in thousands of frictionless marbles for 1 minute. You move through it normally. Another creature entering or starting its turn there must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, and the area is Difficult Terrain even on a success.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #397, Glowing Rose Smooth Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: The magical bonus to AC granted by magic armor you wear increases by 1 while this glowing rose smooth egg orbits your head. It doesn't enhance a shield, Bracers, Ring, or another protective item.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can ask one creature within 30 feet a question. It must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or answer truthfully in no more than ten words, provided it understands the question.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #399, Pale Blue Faceted Lens
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to create a 10-foot Emanation that prevents every creature and object in it from regaining Hit Points or regenerating body parts for 1 minute.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #400, Emerald Green Star
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Single-Use (S)|MECIounStones|Single-Use (S)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This stone never appears orbiting a creature and can be identified only by completing an Ioun bond with it. The moment the bond forms, it transports you and itself into the presence of {@creature Crystalle|MECIounStones} in the Quasi-Elemental Plane of Mineral. Crystalle asks which Ioun Stone you desire, takes the Emerald Green Star, and gives you the requested stone if he deems the exchange acceptable. No other property of the Emerald Green Star is known, and Crystalle permits no creature to retain one.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #401, Brown Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to sense the mood of plants within 60 feet for 1 minute. If you are a Druid, your awareness travels through connected forest roots and branches up to 1 mile in a chosen direction per round. Afterward, you must rest for 1 round per round spent traveling. In your Druid grove, the range doubles and you suffer no fatigue.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #402, Bright Rose Faceted Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to create a fumble field for 1 minute. When a creature misses you with a weapon attack after rolling a natural 1 or 2, it must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or drop one held item of your choice.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The property triggers on a natural 1-4. A creature using a natural weapon instead has the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition on a failed save. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #402, Bright Rose Faceted Helix (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become immune to spells of the listed levels for 1 minute. Helpful and harmful spells are equally blocked. Its rarity is rare for result 1-50, very rare for 51-99, and legendary for 100.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries: Once per day, after you roll percentile dice for a spell or magic item you use, you can increase or decrease the result by 10. This can modify an Ioun Stone's crumble roll. It can't affect an attack roll, saving throw, damage roll, or mundane skill check.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #405, Indigo Blue Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Boosting (B)|MECIounStones|Boosting (B)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This stone depends on five Monk talent tables unique to the source author's campaign and has no defined effect in TGTT. As the source directs, reroll #405 or have the DM replace it with a campaign-specific Monk boon. In the original campaign, a non-Monk gained one random Monk ability, while a Monk rolled on this table.

entries.caption: Original Campaign Effect
rows: Gain one extra ability from Table A.
Gain one extra ability from Table B.
Gain one extra ability from Table C.
Gain one extra ability from Table D.
Gain one extra ability from Table E.
Choose a talent from any table, obeying its restrictions.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, choose a 5-foot-radius Sphere within 30 feet. Immediately and again at the start of each of your next two turns, make one melee spell attack against each creature of your choice in the Sphere, using your Proficiency Bonus and Strength modifier with no magic-item bonuses. Each hit deals {@damage 3d4 + 3} Force damage.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

A restrained creature can repeat the save as an action, ending the condition on a success.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to create a disintegration field in a 2-foot Emanation for 1 minute. A creature that hits you with a melee attack must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 4d4 + 4} Force damage. The field ends after one creature fails this save.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #412, Bright Rose Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to open a Small viewing window onto any Elemental or Outer Plane for 1 minute. You can move the viewpoint freely and perceive through it but can't pass through. A native creature that sees the window can make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw; on a success, it can pass through into the nearest unoccupied space and the window closes.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #413, Clear Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target an object or Medium or smaller creature within 30 feet. A creature can make a DC 20 Charisma saving throw to resist. On a failure, or if it is willing, the target vanishes into a pocket of the Elemental Plane of Earth for 3 rounds, then returns to its former space or the nearest unoccupied space. The DM determines what it experiences there. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #414, Bright Rose Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls against creatures native to the Outer Planes, including creatures native to the Astral Plane.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #416, Bright Blue Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create a 10-foot-square blue crystal glyph on a surface within 30 feet for 1 minute. A Medium or smaller creature touching it is automatically trapped in a crystal energy field for the duration. A Large creature can make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw to avoid entrapment. An entrapped creature has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} and {@condition Restrained|TGTT} conditions and Total Cover. A Huge or larger creature destroys the glyph on contact.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #417, Amber Catseye
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against a true Dragon's breath weapon. On a failed save, you take half damage; on a successful save, you take one-quarter damage. A true Dragon automatically senses this stone within 1 mile and knows its direction.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #418, Dusty Rose Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and roll {@dice 1d100} to create an Emanation of magic resistance for 1 minute. Whenever a spell or magical effect would affect a creature in the Emanation, roll percentile dice; if the result is at or below the listed percentage, that creature is unaffected.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #419, Deep Purple Octahedron
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to detect every Construct of the Golem kind within 30 feet and line of sight for 1 minute. You gain a +2 bonus to melee attack rolls against them, your attacks count as magical against them, and a natural 20 deals twice the attack's maximum possible damage instead of using normal Critical Hit rules.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #420, Lavender Faceted Egg

entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target a Medium or smaller creature within 30 feet. It must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or vanish into a vast extradimensional crystal maze for 1 minute, then return to its former space or the nearest unoccupied space. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The imprisonment lasts 1 hour. The stone remains an artifact. See {@item Ioun Stone #420, Lavender Faceted Egg (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This stone is one of a twinned pair. One bonds to you and the other to your Familiar. While the Familiar is within 30 feet, whenever either of you makes a saving throw, use whichever creature's saving throw modifier is higher. Magical bonuses from other sources aren't transferred.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #422, Bright Blue Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to regenerate 2 Hit Points at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute, to a maximum of 30 Hit Points restored. If the duration exceeds 10 rounds, the stone can also regrow a missing finger or toe.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #423, Deep Purple Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target one Golem within 30 feet. Roll {@dice 1d100}; on 30 or lower, the Golem has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and a Speed of 0 for 1 minute. The effect ends early if the Golem takes damage. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #424, Brown Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and fire a narrow sonic lance at one living creature within 60 feet. It takes {@damage 3d4 + 3} Thunder damage with no saving throw.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #425, Lime Green Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can spend 1 minute creating up to 100 pounds of permanent, nonvaluable clear quartz objects. Each must be a common solid object without moving parts, such as a chair, table, bucket, or length of rope.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #426, Dazzling White Sphere
item.reqAttune: by a cleric, druid, or paladin
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Add 1 to each die rolled by a Cleric, Druid, or Paladin spell you cast to restore Hit Points. This doesn't affect a spell cast from a magic item other than a Spell Scroll. If you are a Paladin, your Lay On Hands pool increases by 3 Hit Points for each of your Paladin levels.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #427, Sky Blue Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain a Fly Speed of 120 feet for 1 minute.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The effect lasts 10 minutes. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #427, Sky Blue Ellipsoid (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #428, Steel Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to transform the sphere into a 12-foot +4 magic lance for 1 minute. It deals {@damage 2d12} Piercing damage and has the Heavy, Reach, and Two-Handed properties. When you hit after moving at least 20 feet straight toward the target and the d20 roll is 19 or 20, roll another {@dice 1d20} for the charge effect.

entries.caption: Crystal Lance Charge
rows: The attack deals its normal damage.
A creature of CR 12 or lower must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or die. Otherwise, quadruple the attack's total damage.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #429, White Smooth Helix

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: These helices are always found as a linked pair and must bond to two Clerics or Druids of the same broad alignment. Once per day, either can activate the pair for 1 minute. Their Bless, Prayer, Chant, and similar spells combine even if their deities differ, and both can cast a healing spell on the same creature during the same turn.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This cube has 4 charges. When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points by damage or ongoing bleeding without dying outright, the stone expends 1 charge and restores you to 1 Hit Point. At 0 charges, it crumbles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #431, Pale Yellow Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can make up to three jumps without expending movement. Each horizontal jump covers up to 20 feet and each vertical jump up to 10 feet. Alternatively, make one horizontal jump of 60 feet or vertical jump of 20 feet.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #432, Light Blue Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target a creature within 60 feet. It must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or suffer an Umber Hulk's Confusing Gaze for 1 minute, rolling each turn to determine its behavior. While this stone orbits, you gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against confusion.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #433, Vibrant Purple Smooth Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target an Earth Elemental within 30 feet. It must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or return immediately to its home plane. You also gain a +4 bonus to checks made to control a summoned Earth Elemental.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The banishment and control bonus apply to every Elemental. A super-charged stone is an artifact. See {@item Ioun Stone #433, Vibrant Purple Smooth Egg (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become imperceptible to Undead of CR 5 or lower for 1 minute. Such Undead can't perceive, target, or react to you. The effect ends immediately after you attack, deal damage, or censure Undead.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: The effect applies to Undead of CR 9 or lower. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #434, Lavender Multi-Faceted Cylinder (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become imperceptible to Undead of CR 5 or lower for 1 minute. Such Undead can't perceive, target, or react to you. The effect ends immediately after you attack, deal damage, or censure Undead.
The effect applies to Undead of CR 9 or lower.
