entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to instantly exchange spaces with one creature you can see within 30 feet. No saving throw is allowed. A spell or attack already directed at one space continues toward whoever now occupies it.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #436, Bright Blue Teardrop
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to fold space in a 10-foot Emanation for 1 minute. You and allied creatures in the area have doubled Speed. This grants no additional actions or attacks.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: Affected creatures have triple Speed. A super-charged stone is an artifact. See {@item Ioun Stone #436, Bright Blue Teardrop (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

Affected creatures have triple Speed.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #436, Bright Blue Teardrop|MECIounStones}.

entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #437, Pale Turquoise Tetragonal
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to replace your hands with mithral-hard digging claws for 1 minute. Each round, you can excavate 5 feet of solid rock or 60 feet of loose earth. The claws are +3 magic weapons; you can make one claw attack as an action, dealing {@damage 3d4} Slashing damage plus your Strength modifier on a hit.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #438, Deep Purple Snowflake
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can open or close a doorway to a permanent demiplane: a stable disc of protomatter 100 feet thick and 300 feet across, with grass, several trees, a renewing pool of pure water, and a small sun. Creatures and plants left there remain safe and sustained. The Prime Material doorway is visible and can be entered by other creatures while open.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #439, Dusty Rose Star
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Choose one ability score when this star bonds to you. That score increases by 2, to a maximum of 22, while it orbits your head. This increase explicitly stacks with {@item Ioun Stone #001, Pale Blue Rhomboid|MECIounStones}, {@item Ioun Stone #002, Scarlet and Blue Sphere|MECIounStones}, {@item Ioun Stone #003, Incandescent Blue Sphere|MECIounStones}, {@item Ioun Stone #004, Deep Red Sphere|MECIounStones}, {@item Ioun Stone #005, Pink Rhomboid|MECIounStones}, or {@item Ioun Stone #006, Pink and Green Sphere|MECIounStones}. A new bonded creature can choose a different score.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #440, Deep Blue Smooth Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to carpet a 15-foot Emanation with elemental crystal spikes for 1 minute. A creature other than you that moves in the area takes {@damage 2d4 + 2} Piercing damage for each round in which it moves.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #441, Pale Yellow Faceted Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Every potion you create while this torus orbits uses the maximum result for each variable numerical effect and duration. The potion requires exceptional ingredients, increasing its material cost by 50 percent.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #442, Brilliant Green Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can ask a cosmic intelligence represented by the DM for advice, a forgotten fact, or an additional clue needed to succeed at a task. The answer contains exactly four words or fewer and is absolutely truthful, without deliberate evasion. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #443, Marbled Blue and White Catseye
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When you cast a Cleric spell with a range of Touch that restores Hit Points, you can target a creature you can see within 30 feet instead. A gossamer strand of blue-white energy connects you to the target until the spell resolves.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #444, Lime Green Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can touch another creature and roll {@dice 1d8} to determine the affected ability. The chosen attribute increases by 4, to a maximum of 20, for 1 minute. On a result of 1, the creature instead gains one effective level for the duration, with all benefits described by {@item Ioun Stone #007, Pale Green Prism|MECIounStones}. On 8, the creature can divide the increase between two abilities in increments of 2.

entries.caption: Instant Amplification
rows: Target's choice, divisible between two abilities

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #445, Maroon Faceted Triangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When you see a creature native to an Outer Plane, roll {@dice 1d100}. On 25 or lower, the stone reveals the creature's true name to you. Such creatures recognize the danger posed by this property and may seek to eliminate you.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #446, Dark Orange Octahedron
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to name a known lost object. For 1 minute, the stone points unerringly toward it, regardless of distance, provided it is on the same plane.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: If the object weighs 20 pounds or less and is on the same plane, it teleports into your free hand or an unoccupied space at your feet. A super-charged stone is an artifact. See {@item Ioun Stone #446, Dark Orange Octahedron (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #446, Dark Orange Octahedron (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to name a known lost object. For 1 minute, the stone points unerringly toward it, regardless of distance, provided it is on the same plane.
If the object weighs 20 pounds or less and is on the same plane, it teleports into your free hand or an unoccupied space at your feet.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #446, Dark Orange Octahedron|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #447, Purple Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain a Swim Speed of 120 feet for 1 minute, even while wearing armor. This property doesn't let you breathe water.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #448, Bright Rose Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Choose one Familiar, mount, or companion creature bonded to you. While it is within 60 feet and this stone orbits your head, it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws and its Hit Point maximum increases by its number of Hit Dice. The stone draws this benefit through your life bond.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #449, Purple Aquamarine Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to create a ring-shaped magnetic field extending from 5 to 20 feet from you for 1 minute. Attacks against you with metallic weapons or ammunition take a -4 penalty. Metallic objects and armored creatures in the ring are pulled toward the ground, which is Difficult Terrain for them.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #450, Brilliant Green Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This sphere requires 14 consecutive days to form its Ioun bond. While it orbits your head, any number of Ioun Stones with identical color and shape stack all their properties and numerical bonuses, including ability-score increases beyond their normal maxima. This is the only general exception to the duplicate-stone restriction.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #451, Pale Lavender Rhomboid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, when you cast a spell with an area of effect, you can reshape its area however you choose without changing its total volume. You can form gaps around allies and bend the area to encompass enemies, provided every affected space remains contiguous with the spell's point of origin. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #452, Dusty Rose Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When your Familiar or mount within your line of sight takes damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to take any amount of that damage in its place, to a maximum total of 2 Hit Points per your level between Long Rests. This transferred damage can't be reduced or redirected.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #453, Pink Dodecahedron
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to emit a subsonic pulse in a 30-foot Cone. Metallic items vibrate violently for 1 minute. Attack rolls made with affected metal weapons take a -2 penalty.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #454, Maroon Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to create a 20-foot Emanation of forbiddance for 1 minute. A hostile creature of CR 10 or lower must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw to enter or willingly move through the area. The effect doesn't stop ranged attacks or spells.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #455, Green Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can spend 1 minute touching one common, nonmagical object weighing no more than 200 pounds. A permanent duplicate appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet. An object made from precious metal or gemstones can't be copied.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #456, Lavender Faceted Cone
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to empower your unarmed strikes for 1 minute. You gain a +2 bonus to their attack rolls, and each hit deals {@damage 1d8 + 4} Bludgeoning damage instead of its normal damage.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: Each hit deals {@damage 1d12 + 6} Bludgeoning damage. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #456, Lavender Faceted Cone (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #456, Lavender Faceted Cone (Super-Charged)
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to empower your unarmed strikes for 1 minute. You gain a +2 bonus to their attack rolls, and each hit deals {@damage 1d8 + 4} Bludgeoning damage instead of its normal damage.
Each hit deals {@damage 1d12 + 6} Bludgeoning damage.
{@b Base Stone:} {@item Ioun Stone #456, Lavender Faceted Cone|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #457, Cerulean Blue Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, at the start of your turn, you can repeat your immediately previous turn exactly. You repeat the same movement, actions, targets, attack rolls, saving throw results, damage rolls, and spell effects without expending the repeated resources again. If an exact repetition is impossible, that part has no effect. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #458, Deep Red Snowflake
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to grant yourself, allied creatures, and magic items in a 10-foot Emanation a +2 bonus to saving throws for 1 minute. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #459, Pearl Brown Smooth Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: These helices are always found as a linked pair and must bond to two Rogues. When one bonded creature attacks a target from hiding or with Advantage while the other is visible to that target and uses its action to distract it, the attacker gains a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls and adds 2 to each Sneak Attack damage die.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #460, Blood Red Faceted Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Charge-Holding (C)|MECIounStones|Charge-Holding (C)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This helix has 2 charges. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 charge and target an evil creature native to a Lower Outer Plane within 60 feet. It must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be banished to its home plane. At 0 charges, the stone crumbles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #461, Deep Purple Faceted Cone
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to empower the stone until the start of your next turn. Whenever an attack or a spell targeting only you deals Hit Point damage to you, its source takes the same amount and type of damage. Breath weapons and other area effects aren't reflected. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #462, Pink Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: After the stone has been exposed to direct sunlight for 24 total hours, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to release 5 beams of sunlight. Each beam strikes a randomly determined Undead within 30 feet and deals {@damage 4d6 + 4} Radiant damage. Multiple beams can strike the same target. The stone must absorb another 24 hours of sunlight before it can be used again.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #463, Pale Green Dodecahedron
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and choose one creature of any Size. For 1 minute, you don't exist from that creature's perspective: it can't perceive, target, react to, or account for you. A creature of CR 11 or higher can make a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw to resist. The effect ends immediately after you attack or affect the creature and can't begin while it is grappling or holding you.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #464, Pink and Green Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reverse time in a 30-foot Emanation. Each allied creature in the area regains Hit Points equal to half the damage it took from weapon attacks and natural weapons during the previous round. Spell and other magical damage isn't reversed. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #465, Lavender Teardrop
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This teardrop has 2 charges that can't be restored by any means short of Crystalle. When you or a magic item you carry fails a saving throw, when you miss an attack, or when a disastrous event damages you, you can expend 1 charge without an action to turn the failure into a success, the miss into a hit, or completely negate that event's damage and harmful effects on you through improbable intervention. At 0 charges, the stone crumbles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #466, Pale Lavender Smooth Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, after handling an object weighing less than 100 pounds for 10 minutes, you can create an exact duplicate for 1 minute. Magic items and weapons retain all their properties. A particular object can be duplicated by this stone only once, ever. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #467, Purple Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to navigate multiple realities for 3 rounds. Whenever you make an attack roll, saving throw, ability check, or damage roll, roll it three times and choose which result occurs. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #468, Dark Orange Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to create a 20-foot Emanation of fresh Elemental air for 1 minute. Creatures can breathe normally there underwater or amid harmful gas. If active before a gas-based breath weapon, creatures in the area gain a +2 bonus to its saving throw and Resistance to its damage.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #469, Lavender Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can perceive a silent psychic vision of a dead creature's final minutes. The vision lasts 3 rounds if you touch its remains or 1 round if the remains are within 30 feet. You experience the scene from the creature's perspective, including dangerous sensory impressions at the DM's discretion.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #470, Dusty Rose Smooth Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: These helices are always found as a linked pair and must bond to two Wizards. If both cast the same spell at the same target during the same round, targets take a -2 penalty to saving throws against both spells, and Magic Resistance or similar Advantage on saving throws against magic is suppressed for those spells.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #471, Orange Dodecahedron
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to drive loose rock and soil away from you in a 60-foot Cone that is 30 feet wide at its end. The debris advances 20 feet each round for 3 rounds. A Medium or smaller creature caught by it takes {@damage 2d4 + 2} Bludgeoning damage and is carried with the flow unless it succeeds on a DC 18 Strength saving throw.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #472, Cobalt Blue Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Your body temperature matches the surrounding environment while this cobalt blue ellipsoid orbits your head. You are invisible to thermal imaging and other senses that detect body heat.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #473, Soft Black Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target a Wand, Staff, or Rod within 30 feet. Its wielder must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or the item's magical properties are suppressed for 1 minute.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #474, Indigo Blue Snowflake
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to make stone tendrils fill a 20-foot-diameter circle within 30 feet for 1 minute. The area is Difficult Terrain. A creature entering or starting its turn there is entangled, reducing its Speed to 10 feet; roll {@dice 1d100}, and on 30 or lower it instead has the {@condition Restrained|TGTT} condition until it succeeds on a DC 20 Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check as an action.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #475, Bright Rose Smooth Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: These helices are always found as a linked pair and must bond to two different creatures. The two creatures can freely exchange any Ioun Stone between them without a new Ioun bond. While within 10 feet and not Incapacitated, either can transfer an orbiting stone to the other by thought alone without an action; otherwise, the stone must be physically passed.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #476, Dark Green Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to become any height from 6 inches to 12 feet for 1 minute. Your equipment changes with you, and your Size becomes Tiny, Small, Medium, or Large as appropriate. No other game statistic changes. You can end the effect early as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #477, White Octahedron
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to empower the stone for 1 minute. Add 1 to every numerical bonus or penalty created by a Bless, Bane, Prayer, Chant, or similar divine spell you cast during this time; for example, {@spell Bless|XPHB} grants {@dice 1d4 + 1}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #478, Emerald Green Smooth Helix
item.reqAttune: by a barbarian, fighter, paladin, or ranger
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: These helices are always found as a linked pair and must bond to two martial characters. Once per day, either can activate the pair for 1 minute. While both attack the same creature in melee, each gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls against it.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #479, Maroon Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You and one Familiar or mount bonded to you share a reserve of 10 Hit Points while within 60 feet. When either would take damage, you can deduct some or all of it from this reserve instead. The reserve returns to 10 when you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #480, Flashing Yellow Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: While this spindle orbits, two ability scores increase by 2, to a maximum of 20. Roll {@dice 1d20} when it first bonds to determine the pair.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #481, Glowing Rose Smooth Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain a +6 bonus to AC against melee attacks for 1 minute. You can't make attacks while this property is active. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #482, Lavender Faceted Pyramid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target a creature within 30 feet. It must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or become the center of a cacophony of noise, flickering light, foul smells, wind, and dust for 1 minute. On a success, the effect appears in an adjacent space and doesn't move. A creature at the center must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw whenever it casts a spell or the spell fails and its resources are wasted. {@i The source omits the duration; this conversion uses its standard 2d3 + 2-round limited-effect duration.}

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #483, Lime Green Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, when you make an attack from hiding against a surprised creature, you gain a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls. On a hit, add 3 Sneak Attack dice to the attack.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules

item.name: Ioun Stone #484, Cobalt Blue Snowflake

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to release super-fine salt dust from the Quasi-Elemental Plane of Salt around a point within 30 feet. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition for 3 rounds. Creatures susceptible to desiccation suffer an additional severe effect determined by the DM.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #485, Yellow Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to release superheated vapor from the Quasi-Elemental Plane of Steam in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered within 30 feet. Each creature in the area takes {@damage 3d4 + 3} Fire damage. The effect functions underwater. At a liquid surface, it also creates heavily obscuring steam that blocks Darkvision and thermal sight until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #486, Clear Pink Smooth Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to empower the stone for 1 minute. When your weapon attack roll is a natural 18-20, the target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or drop one weapon it holds. Natural weapons are unaffected.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #487, Deep Purple Faceted Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to see every mechanical trap hidden by natural stone within 30 feet for 3 rounds, including its moving parts and likely trigger. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #488, Pulsing White Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against curses. If a curse normally allows no saving throw, you can make a Charisma saving throw against DC 20 with a -2 penalty to avoid it. This doesn't protect against a curse imposed directly by a deity, an artifact, or a flawed Ioun Stone.

entries.name: Super-Charged Stone
entries: You are immune to ordinary curses while the stone orbits, with the same exceptions. A super-charged stone is legendary. See {@item Ioun Stone #488, Pulsing White Cube (Super-Charged)|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can cast a spell of level 2 or lower into the mind of a willing creature, Familiar, or companion you touch. It remains implanted for a number of days equal to your level, and you can prepare another spell in its place. While within 30 feet of the host, you can speak one word to release the spell without an action; it originates from the host, and you can cast another spell normally during the same turn. A host can contain only one implanted spell.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #490, Blood Red Teardrop

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to double the number of attacks you make with ranged weapons for 3 rounds. This property doesn't multiply additional attacks granted by an Archer subclass or equivalent specialized feature.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make a 20-foot Emanation on the surface of any noncorrosive liquid support any number of creatures and mounts that fit in the area for 1 minute. The buoyant area moves across the surface with you at your Speed.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This lozenge guards another Ioun Stone; roll again on the six numbered tables to determine which one. A neutral Dao is bound to the lozenge, which has 2 charges. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 charge to summon the Dao. It first ensures the guarded stone is safe, then fulfills one reasonable request. If summoned frivolously, it deliberately perverts the request. After the last charge, the Dao takes this lozenge and the guarded stone back to the Quasi-Elemental Plane of Mineral.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target one creature within 30 feet. Every defensive spell of level 4 or lower affecting it is attacked. For each, the creature must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or that spell is shredded and ends. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Your sense of smell is supernaturally keen. You have Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks relying on smell, and a Ranger or another creature trained to track has a 50 percent chance to follow an animal solely by scent even where no physical trail remains.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can touch a naturally grown nonmagical material, such as leather, wood, or rope, and give it the hardness of enchanted steel for 10 minutes without reducing its flexibility. It gains a +3 bonus to saving throws and Resistance to all damage. Leather armor treated this way grants a +3 bonus to AC for the duration but gains no magic-item saving throw bonus.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to transport yourself and your worn and carried equipment to almost any plane of existence for 1 minute. The stone alters your form enough to breathe, move, perceive, and survive the plane's ambient conditions. When the duration ends, you return to the space you left or the nearest unoccupied space. Creatures and localized hazards remain dangerous.

entries.name: Stone Effect

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create a 10-foot-diameter ball of lightning at a point within 30 feet. Every creature wearing or carrying significant metal within 10 feet of the ball takes {@damage 2d4 + 4} Lightning damage, doubled if it is wet or standing in water. The ball vanishes immediately and doesn't distinguish friend from foe.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #499, Pearl White Cube

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action while holding one willing creature to transport both of you to the border between the Positive Energy Plane and the Quasi-Elemental Plane of Mineral for 1 minute. At the start of each round, the DM secretly rolls {@dice 2d10 + 2}; each of you gains that many Hit Points, even above your maximum. If either creature ever has more than twice its Hit Point maximum, it transforms into pure energy and is irrevocably destroyed except by {@spell Wish|XPHB}. When the duration ends, you return. Excess Hit Points remain for 24 hours and can be lost to damage normally. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}
