item.name: Ioun Stone #545, Deep Red Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to empower your melee strikes for 1 minute. When you hit a Medium or smaller creature with a melee attack, it is pushed {@dice 1d10} feet. Until the end of its next turn, its attacks take a -2 penalty and deal half damage. A super-charged stone can push a creature of any Size and is legendary.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #546, Purple and White Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create a pea-sized spark at a point within 30 feet. It expands into a 10-foot-diameter Sphere, and each creature in the area takes {@damage 4d4} Fire damage.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #547, Pale Green Catseye
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create a pea-sized mote of ice at a point within 30 feet. It expands into a 10-foot-diameter Sphere, and each creature in the area takes {@damage 4d4} Cold damage.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #548, Pearl Brown Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create a pea-sized electrical mote at a point within 30 feet. It expands into a 10-foot-diameter Sphere, and each creature in the area takes {@damage 4d4} Lightning damage.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #549, Deep Black Faceted Lens
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to create a pea-sized mote of water at a point within 30 feet. It expands into a 10-foot-diameter Sphere. Each fire-based creature in the area takes {@damage 4d4} Cold damage; other creatures are drenched but unharmed.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #550, Bright White Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to inspire allied Lawful creatures in a 30-foot Emanation for 1 minute. Each gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, AC, and saving throws. Only one such stone is recorded.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #551, Pale Aquamarine Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to breathe water for 1 minute.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #552, Maroon Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to create a 30-foot Emanation of demonic rejection for 1 minute. A Fiend in the area attempting to summon or gate another Fiend reduces its chance of success by 25 percentage points; if no roll is normally required, it succeeds only on a roll of 6 on {@dice 1d6}. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}. The stone crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower; increase this chance by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #553, Small Bright Blue Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Micro|MECIounStones|Micro}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, when you would fail a saving throw against the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition, you succeed instead.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #554, Pale Blue Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can activate this rod with another Ioun Stone to double every numerical bonus, range, area, duration, damage, healing, charge expenditure, and other scalable effect of one use of that stone. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100} separately for both stones; each crumbles on a roll of 50 or lower, increasing by 10 for each previous doubled use. The DM adjudicates effects that can't coherently be doubled.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #555, Pale Lavender Smooth Helix
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: These helices are always found as a linked pair and must bond to two different creatures. Whenever either creature makes a saving throw, it can use the higher of their two base saving throw modifiers. Magical bonuses don't transfer, except bonuses granted by another Ioun Stone.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #556, Red Snowflake
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: If you are missing a hand, foot, arm, or leg, this stone creates a hazy energy limb that functions exactly like the missing appendage while it orbits your head.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #557, Small Clear Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Micro|MECIounStones|Micro}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Whenever a spell or magical effect would affect you, roll {@dice 1d100}; on 2 or lower, you are unaffected. If placed in an Ioun-sand matrix, this chance stacks with other Small Clear Spheres and every other source of percentile Magic Resistance.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #558, Ruby Red Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to coat one weapon in sharp crystal for 1 minute. On a hit, it deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #559, Bright Green Faceted Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Roll {@dice 1d6} when this torus first bonds to determine its ability. Once every 7 days, when you touch a creature, the target's chosen score decreases by 4, but not below 15, and yours increases by the amount actually lost, with no maximum, for 1 minute.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #560, Pale Green Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to bring 1 cubic foot of water within 30 feet instantly to its boiling point. Water that is part of a creature is unaffected. A super-charged stone converts the water instantly to steam, creating extreme pressure whose consequences the DM determines, and is very rare.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #561, White Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: After this stone bonds to you, you can touch one magic item that can be held in one hand to fuse it inside the cylinder. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can place the stored item instantly in your free hand. The cylinder can store only one item at a time.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #562, Small Pale Yellow Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Micro|MECIounStones|Micro}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can jump up to 30 feet horizontally or 15 feet vertically without expending movement.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #563, Bright Blue Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This rod has 3 charges. When you are targeted by a psionic attack or effect, you can expend 1 charge without an action to make your Intelligence 22 for the purpose of resisting it and to gain Advantage on its saving throw. At 0 charges, the rod crumbles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #564, Lavender Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When you place this prism in orbit, it shrinks and orbits your Familiar instead. The Familiar gains one additional Hit Point Die of its normal type, increasing its Hit Point maximum by the die's maximum result plus its Constitution modifier. The benefit ends if the prism stops orbiting it or your bond to the stone ends.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #565, Bright Silver Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can create a mirror-like field for 3 seconds between you and a Medium or smaller creature within 30 feet. It must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be trapped inside the stone, where it experiences no time. The stone can hold only one creature. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can release it into an unoccupied space within 30 feet.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #566, Small Pearly White Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Micro|MECIounStones|Micro}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: While this spindle orbits and you have at least 1 Hit Point, you regain 1 Hit Point at the end of each hour. It can regrow body parts using twice the times listed for {@item Ioun Stone #010, Pearly White Spindle|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #567, Ochre Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When you would be disintegrated or reduced to dust by a spell or magical effect, the stone negates that destruction and any damage from the effect. Then roll {@dice 1d100}; the stone crumbles on 50 or lower, increasing by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #568, Lavender Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: After this stone bonds to you, you can spend 24 hours bonding it to one specific magic item weighing 10 pounds or less. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can absorb that item into the stone or call it forth into your free hand. It is undetectable while stored.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #569, Small Yellow Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Micro|MECIounStones|Micro}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target one creature within 60 feet. It must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition for 3 rounds. An Undead also takes {@damage 1d6} Radiant damage and must look away until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #570, Pale Lavender Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: The stone functions as a tireless third hand. By thought alone, you can have it carry or hold an object weighing 1 pound or less, stir a pot, turn a page, open an unlocked container, or perform a similar mundane task within 3 feet of you. It can't attack, activate a magic item, or perform a task requiring a free hand for spellcasting.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #571, Blood Red Smooth Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You can speak a message of 20 words or fewer into the stone, then name or point out a recipient whose location the stone can reach physically. It flies at 50 feet per round, delivers the message in your voice and volume, then returns by the same route. It avoids obstacles but can't teleport or cross planar boundaries.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #572, Purple Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You can designate your current location by spending 1 minute there. Until you designate another location, the stone always tells you its direction and approximate distance, provided it is on the same plane.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #573, Dark Orange Teardrop
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Choose one ordinary craft when this stone bonds to you, such as carpentry, smithing, pottery, weaving, painting, sculpting, or brewing. You gain Expertise with the relevant tools, and items you produce are of exceptional quality and can normally be sold for 50 percent more.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #574, Pink and Green Faceted Lens
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: You can touch one object weighing 1 pound or less to absorb it into the stone for up to 1 minute. You can then send the stone at 50 feet per round to a named or visible recipient within 100 feet. It releases the object into the recipient's free hand or at its feet, then returns.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #575, Dark Blue Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Every magical oil, lotion, powder, or paste you create while this lozenge orbits uses the maximum result for each variable numerical effect and duration. It requires exceptional ingredients, increasing its material cost by 200 percent.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #576, Deep Blue Snowflake
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to sheathe one weapon you hold in intense cold for 1 minute. On a hit, it deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Cold damage.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #577, Ruby Red Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can scan one creature within 60 feet. You learn whether its level or CR is lower than, equal to, or higher than your level.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #578, Indigo Blue Smooth Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, when you attempt to grasp or net another creature's orbiting Ioun Stone, add 4 to your attack roll or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check. This property applies to one attempt only.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #579, Maroon Catseye
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once every 7 days, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to create a 20-foot Emanation of suppressive energy for 1 minute. Every spell cast into, out of, or within the area deals half damage, restores half as many Hit Points, and has half its normal duration, rounding down to a minimum of 1 round.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #580, Black Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Charge-Holding (C)|MECIounStones|Charge-Holding (C)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This sphere has 3 charges. Once every 7 days, you can expend 1 charge as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to empower allied Chaotic Evil creatures in a 30-foot Emanation for 1 minute. Each gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, AC, and saving throws. At 0 charges, the stone crumbles. No effect, including {@item Ioun Stone #277, Lavender and Green Faceted Egg|MECIounStones} or {@spell Wish|XPHB}, can restore its charges.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #581, Glowing Rose Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to create a sundering barrier for 1 minute. Each physical projectile targeting you must succeed on a DC 18 Constitution saving throw or shatter before reaching you, including arrows, bolts, sling stones, spears, daggers, and throwing axes. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}; the stone crumbles on 50 or lower, increasing by 10 for each previous use.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #582, Maroon Prism
item.reqAttune: by a cleric, druid, or paladin
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: While this prism orbits, choose one spell from your class list that is one level higher than the highest-level spell you can normally prepare or cast, to a maximum of level 9. That spell is always prepared, and you gain one Spell Slot of its level, which you regain when you finish a Long Rest. The DM decides whether your deity grants the requested spell.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #583, Cobalt Blue Faceted Egg
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and target one magically created solid wall within 20 feet, including a Wall of Stone, Ice, Wood, Iron, or Force. There is a {@chance 50|50 percent|Wall Collapse} chance the wall collapses and ends. Afterward, roll {@dice 1d100}; the stone crumbles on 50 or lower, increasing by 10 for each previous use. A super-charged stone instead lets you pass through any magical wall at will without expending a use and remains an artifact.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #584, Orange Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to transform yourself and your equipment into a nonbreathing liquid for 1 minute. You can be poured into a container, pass through liquid-tight openings, and flow 5 feet per round on a sloped surface. You can't attack, cast spells, or manipulate objects.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #585, Pearl Brown Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to assume the exact physical appearance of one Medium or smaller creature you saw during the last 24 hours for 1 minute. You gain none of its abilities or Hit Points.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #586, Crystal Clear Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can touch a creature and make the bones in its limbs soft and pliable for 3 rounds. It can reach into narrow spaces and automatically escapes nonmagical bonds around its limbs. The cube is nearly invisible, requiring a DC 25 Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) check to notice. A super-charged stone affects the entire skeleton, allowing the creature to pass through openings as narrow as 1 inch, and is legendary.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #587, Deep Black Twisted Hexagonal Rod
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When damage reduces you to 0 Hit Points and kills you outright, the stone immediately blasts the attacker with Negative Energy. If the attacker's current Hit Points are no greater than your Hit Point maximum, it must succeed on a DC 22 Constitution saving throw or die. The stone then crumbles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #588, Pale Green Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: If you have levels in two or more classes, you gain one full level in every one of those classes while this pale green cylinder orbits your head, including Hit Dice, Hit Points, class features, Spell Slots, and other benefits. It can raise individual class levels and your total level above 20. It grants no benefit to a single-classed character.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #589, Pearl Brown Spindle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to suppress fire in a 20-foot Emanation for 1 minute. You can extinguish a normal fire in the area without an action. A Fire spell of level 5 or lower has a 50 percent chance to deal half damage and create half its normal area; a level 6 or higher Fire spell has a 25 percent chance. Roll separately for each spell.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #590, Lime Green Catseye
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Roll {@dice 1d6} when this catseye first bonds to determine its ability. Once per day, you can touch a creature to increase that score by 2, to a maximum of 20, for 1 minute.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #591, Amber Ellipsoid
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to assess creatures for 1 minute. Once on each turn, choose one creature within 30 feet; you learn its current and maximum Hit Points and every disease affecting it.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #592, Maroon Faceted Torus
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Choose one spell from your class list that is one level higher than the highest-level spell you can normally prepare or cast, to a maximum of level 9. It must be in your spellbook or on a Spell Scroll; a scroll used this way is consumed. The spell is always prepared while the torus orbits, and you gain one Spell Slot of its level, which you regain when you finish a Long Rest.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #593, Clear Pink Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This rectangle has 3 charges. When another Ioun Stone makes a percentile roll or ability check to function, you can expend 1 charge to add 10 percentage points or +2 to that roll. Alternatively, subtract 10 percentage points from that stone's crumble chance for one use. At 0 charges, this stone crumbles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #594, Bright Blue Cylinder
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Instant (I)|MECIounStones|Instant (I)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When this cylinder completes its Ioun bond, roll {@dice 1d20} and gain the indicated Experience Points, but no more than enough to gain one level. The stone then crumbles.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #595, Dark Blue Sphere
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can cover your head in thin blue crystal equivalent to a metal helmet. Attacks and hazards specifically targeting your head treat its AC as 18. The helmet doesn't interfere with vision or hearing and remains until dismissed as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #596, Lime Green Lozenge
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: When your current Hit Points first fall to half your maximum or lower, the stone activates automatically. Roll an unmodified {@dice 1d20}; on 10 or lower, you have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition until fully healed. At the start of each of your turns while below your Hit Point maximum, you regain 1 Hit Point. Missing body parts regrow in half the times listed for {@item Ioun Stone #010, Pearly White Spindle|MECIounStones}.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #597, Small Ochre Rectangle
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Micro|MECIounStones|Micro}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain a Gnome's stone sense for 2 rounds. You know your approximate depth, the direction of slopes, and whether nearby stone is natural or worked, and have Advantage on checks to identify minerals or stonework. A Gnome gains no benefit.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #598, Small Gray Cube
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Micro|MECIounStones|Micro}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Voluntary (V)|MECIounStones|Voluntary (V)}, {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Limited (L)|MECIounStones|Limited (L)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: Once per day, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to gain a Dwarf's stone sense for 2 rounds. You have Advantage on checks to detect unsafe stonework, stone traps, sliding or shifting walls, and concealed passages in stone. A Dwarf gains no benefit.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #599, Blood Red Prism
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Temporary (T)|MECIounStones|Temporary (T)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can unleash a bolt at one target within 30 feet, dealing {@damage 8d8 + 8} Force damage. Then roll {@dice 1d100}; the stone crumbles on 50 or lower, increasing by 10 for each previous use. A rumored variant instead fills a 30-foot Cone that is 20 feet wide at its end, dealing the same damage to each creature there, and is an artifact.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

item.name: Ioun Stone #600, Pale Lavender Dodecahedron
entries: {@b Source Type:} {@variantrule Ioun Source Type: Permanent (P)|MECIounStones|Permanent (P)}.

entries.name: Stone Effect
entries: This dodecahedron requires the normal 7-day Ioun bond. Afterward, every other Ioun Stone bonds to you instantly when you touch it and place it in orbit. A stone loaned by another creature bonds to you instantly, but must complete a new 7-day bond when returned to its former creature.

entries.name: General Ioun Stone Rules
entries: {#itemEntry Moorchlyne Ioun Stone|MECIounStones}

trait.name: Crystal Body
entries: The Shard is immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. It has Resistance to that damage from magic weapons with a bonus lower than +3. When subjected to Lightning damage, it takes no damage instead of half damage if an effect allows it to make a saving throw and it succeeds.

trait.name: Magic Resistance (15 Percent)
entries: Whenever a spell or another magical effect would affect the Shard, roll {@dice 1d100}. On a roll of 15 or lower, the Shard is unaffected.

trait.name: Mineral Glide
entries: The Shard can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, it doesn't disturb the material it moves through. If a Phase Door or similar spell targets the stone it occupies while it is gliding, the Shard dies instantly.

trait.name: Crystal Susceptibility
entries: A spell or effect that shatters crystal deals an extra {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage to the Shard. A Stone to Flesh effect that overcomes its Magic Resistance reduces its AC to 16 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Ioun Affinity
entries: The Shard can form Ioun bonds and use Ioun Stones despite lacking humanoid anatomy.

action.name: Razor Slash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d8 + 10}) Slashing damage. The attack counts as a +2 magic weapon only for overcoming defenses and interacting with other rules.

action.name: Color Burst (1/Day)
entries: The Shard spins and emits paralyzing color in a 30-foot Emanation. Each other creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|TGTT} condition for 1 minute. Attacks against a creature stunned this way gain a +4 bonus in addition to any Advantage. After using this action, the Shard must use its movement on each turn to flee toward the nearest mass of stone or source of Positive Energy while a hostile creature it can perceive is within 60 feet and able to attack it.

trait.name: Crystal Body
entries: The Glomus is immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Bludgeoning damage from a +2 or better magic weapon is doubled against it. When subjected to Lightning damage, it takes no damage instead of half damage if it succeeds on an allowed saving throw.

trait.name: Magic Resistance (30 Percent)
entries: Whenever a spell or magical effect would affect the Glomus, roll {@dice 1d100}. On 30 or lower, it is unaffected.

trait.name: Mineral Glide
entries: The Glomus can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone without disturbing it. A Phase Door effect targeting its occupied stone kills it instantly.

trait.name: Reformation
entries: When reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Glomus explodes. Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation makes a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. Ten inert major crystals then fall in its space. Each crystal is a Tiny object with AC 16, 5 Hit Points, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. Unless every major crystal is destroyed, the Glomus reforms after 1 day per remaining Hit Point Die. When it reforms, reduce its Hit Point Dice by {@dice 1d4}, to a minimum of 1, and recalculate its Hit Point maximum from its remaining Hit Point Dice. If it dies away from the Plane of Mineral, its remains include gemstones worth {@dice 2d10 * 500} gp.

trait.name: Crystal Susceptibility
entries: Crystal-shattering magic deals an extra {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage. Stone to Flesh reduces its AC to 16 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Ioun Affinity
entries: The Glomus has a 50 percent chance to possess two Ioun Stones and can use them.

action.name: Crystal Ram
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 10d4}) Bludgeoning and Piercing damage.

action.name: Glittering Curtain (1/Day)
entries: The Glomus fills a 20-foot Emanation with overwhelming color. Each other creature there must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Stunned|TGTT} conditions for 1 minute.

trait.name: Crystal Body
entries: The crysmal is immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. A magic weapon with a bonus lower than +2 has a 20 percent chance to shatter after hitting it. It takes no Lightning damage instead of half on a successful saving throw.

trait.name: Magic Resistance (45 Percent)
entries: Whenever magic would affect the crysmal, roll {@dice 1d100}. On 45 or lower, it is unaffected.

trait.name: Mineral Glide
entries: The crysmal moves through unworked earth and stone without disturbing it. Phase Door kills it while gliding.

trait.name: Crystal Susceptibility
entries: Crystal-shattering magic deals an extra {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage. Stone to Flesh reduces its AC to 16 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Ioun Affinity
entries: The crysmal has a 50 percent chance to possess two Ioun Stones and can use them.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crysmal makes six Crystal Leg attacks, but no more than two against one target.

action.name: Crystal Leg
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Crystal Darts (1/Day)
entries: The crysmal makes six ranged attacks: {@atk rw} {@hit 8} to hit, range 60 ft., one target per dart. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage. The first dart to hit a creature embeds {@dice 2d4} splinters in it. While it has any splinters, its Strength is reduced by 2 and its Dexterity by 4, to a minimum of 1; these reductions don't stack with additional Crystal Darts. It takes {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage whenever it moves more than 5 feet or makes an attack. A creature can take a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to remove one splinter, taking 1 Piercing damage. If magical healing is applied during the action, any number of splinters can be removed without dealing this damage. The reductions end when all splinters are removed.

trait.name: Crystal Body
entries: The Spined Shard is immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. A +1 magic weapon has a 25 percent chance to melt after hitting it. It takes no Lightning damage instead of half on a successful saving throw.

trait.name: Magic Resistance (45 Percent)
entries: Whenever magic would affect the Spined Shard, roll {@dice 1d100}. On 45 or lower, it is unaffected.

trait.name: Mineral Glide
entries: The Spined Shard moves through unworked earth and stone without disturbing it. Phase Door kills it while gliding.

trait.name: Crystal Susceptibility
entries: Crystal-shattering magic deals an extra {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage. Stone to Flesh reduces its AC to 16 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Ioun Affinity
entries: The Spined Shard has a 25 percent chance to possess two Ioun Stones and can use them.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Spined Shard makes four Tentacle attacks. It can then use Positive Stinger once against a creature hit by at least two of those attacks that remains Grappled by at least two Tentacles.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) Slashing damage. On a hit, the target is Grappled (escape {@dc 17}). The Spined Shard has four Tentacles, each of which can grapple one creature. A Tentacle's grapple ends if that Tentacle attacks another target.

action.name: Positive Stinger
entries: One creature Grappled by at least two Tentacles takes 26 ({@damage 4d12}) Radiant damage.

action.name: Energy Burst (4/Day)
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 7} to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d12}) Radiant damage. On a hit, there is a {@chance 50|50 percent|Arcing Energy} chance that energy arcs to a random creature within 10 feet, which makes a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 13 ({@damage 2d12}) Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. After the fourth use, the Spined Shard normally flees to the Positive Energy Plane to recharge.

trait.name: Crystal Body
entries: The crysmal is immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. It takes no Lightning damage instead of half on a successful saving throw.

trait.name: Mineral Glide
entries: The crysmal moves through unworked earth and stone without disturbing it. Phase Door kills it while gliding.

trait.name: Crystal Susceptibility
entries: Crystal-shattering magic deals an extra {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage. Stone to Flesh reduces its AC to 16 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The crysmal makes two Stilt-Leg attacks.

action.name: Stilt-Leg
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Shard Volley (2/Day)
entries: The crysmal fires {@dice 2d6} shards, dividing them among targets within 60 feet. Make a ranged attack for each shard: {@atk rw} {@hit 6} to hit. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

trait.name: Magic Resistance (15 Percent)
entries: Whenever a spell or magical effect would affect the Giant, roll {@dice 1d100}. On 15 or lower, it is unaffected.

trait.name: Crystal Body
entries: The Giant can be damaged by nonmagical weapons. When subjected to Lightning damage, it takes no damage instead of half damage if it succeeds on an allowed saving throw.

trait.name: Crystal Susceptibility
entries: Crystal-shattering magic deals an extra {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage. A Glassee effect gives the Giant the {@condition Stunned|TGTT} condition for 3 rounds. Stone to Flesh reduces its AC to 16 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Crystal Greatclub
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d8 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Crystal Boulder
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 12} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}24 ({@damage 3d10 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Energy Nodules
entries: The Pod begins with one shared pool of 15 energy nodules. Each Tendril attack ruptures {@dice 2d4} nodules from this pool. If it has fewer nodules than the number rolled, all remaining nodules rupture. The Pod can't make a Tendril attack while it has no nodules. New nodules normally take hours of exposure to Positive Energy to grow.

trait.name: Spell Absorption
entries: The Pod automatically absorbs any spell or magical effect that would affect it and is unaffected. For every 3 spell levels absorbed, it grows one energy nodule; a cantrip contributes no levels. This property functions in addition to its 75 percent Magic Resistance.

trait.name: Magic Resistance (75 Percent)
entries: Whenever a magical effect other than a spell would affect the Pod, roll {@dice 1d100}. On 75 or lower, it is unaffected.

trait.name: Crystal Body
entries: The Pod is immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks and magic weapons with a bonus lower than +3. When a lesser magic weapon hits the Pod, that weapon's wielder must succeed on a DC 18 Charisma saving throw or the weapon permanently loses its magical properties. The Pod takes no Lightning damage instead of half on a successful saving throw.

trait.name: Mineral Glide
entries: The Pod moves through unworked earth and stone without disturbing it. Phase Door deals {@damage 2d10} Force damage to it while gliding.

trait.name: Crystal Susceptibility
entries: Crystal-shattering magic deals an extra {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage. Stone to Flesh reduces its AC to 16 until the end of its next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Pod makes up to six Tendril attacks, no more than two against one creature. It stops making attacks when its shared nodule pool is empty.

action.name: Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. The Pod ruptures {@dice 2d4} nodules, and the target takes 4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Radiant damage per ruptured nodule.

action.name: Catastrophic Discharge (1/Day)
entries: The Pod ruptures every remaining nodule in a 15-foot Emanation. Each other creature there makes a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Radiant damage per nodule on a failed save or half as much on a success. The Pod then must flee toward the Positive Energy Plane or Quasi-Elemental Plane of Mineral.

trait.name: Variable Colossus
entries: Chamrols range from 15 to 500 feet long. This stat block represents a 200-foot specimen. For every full 50 feet larger or smaller, adjust its Hit Point maximum by 40, to a minimum of 50 Hit Points, and its Positive Energy Bolt healing by {@dice 5d10}, to a minimum of {@dice 5d10}. Its roots and stationary nature prevent forced movement.

trait.name: Crystal Body
entries: The Chamrol is immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks and magic weapons with a bonus lower than +3. It takes no Lightning damage instead of half on a successful saving throw.

trait.name: Magic Resistance (75 Percent)
entries: Whenever magic would affect the Chamrol, roll {@dice 1d100}. On 75 or lower, it is unaffected.

trait.name: Crystal Susceptibility
entries: Crystal-shattering magic deals an extra {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage. A Glassee effect gives it the {@condition Stunned|TGTT} condition for 3 rounds. Stone to Flesh reduces its AC to 16 until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Precious Body
entries: A destroyed Chamrol contains immense quantities of lead and rare minerals. One percent are primarily gold and are effectively priceless.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Chamrol makes six Tendril attacks, no more than two against one target.

action.name: Tendril
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 16} to hit, reach 100 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d6 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage. On a hit, roll {@dice 1d100}; on 15 or lower, the target is Grappled (escape {@dc 20}). Until the grapple ends, it takes 19 ({@damage 2d10 + 8}) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each Chamrol turn. A creature killed while grappled is hurled into the Positive Energy Plane and destroyed.

action.name: Positive Energy Bolt (1/Day)
entries: The Chamrol fires a 120-foot-long, 30-foot-wide Line. Each creature there makes a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. The DM rolls 110 ({@dice 20d10}) in secret; a creature gains that many Hit Points on a failed save or half as many on a success. These can exceed its Hit Point maximum and remain for 24 hours or until lost. If its current Hit Points exceed twice its maximum, it explodes and dies.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Quaartzz fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Crystal Body
entries: Quaartzz is immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks and magic weapons with a bonus lower than +3. A lesser weapon that hits him must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be destroyed. Quaartzz takes no Lightning damage instead of half on a successful saving throw.

trait.name: Magic Resistance (65 Percent)
entries: Whenever a spell or magical effect would affect Quaartzz, roll {@dice 1d100}. On 65 or lower, he is unaffected.

trait.name: Mineral Glide
entries: Quaartzz moves through unworked earth and stone without disturbing it. Phase Door deals {@damage 2d10} Force damage to him while gliding.

trait.name: Crystal Regeneration
entries: Quaartzz regains 5 Hit Points at the start of his turn while on the Quasi-Elemental Plane of Mineral. If he takes Thunder damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Crystal Susceptibility
entries: Crystal-shattering magic deals an extra {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage. A Glassee effect gives Quaartzz the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition for 3 rounds. Stone to Flesh reduces his AC to 16 until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Ioun Cloud
entries: Quaartzz normally has twenty-four Ioun Stones in orbit. The DM chooses or rolls them from the numbered tables. Duplicate stones stack for him. He can activate one Voluntary or Limited Ioun Stone property at the start of each of his turns without using an action. His listed CR doesn't include additional damage, healing, or defenses supplied by the chosen stones.

trait.name: Crystal Giant Retinue
entries: Quaartzz is normally accompanied by {@dice 1d4} {@creature Crystal Stone Giant|MECIounStones|Crystal Stone Giants}. His listed CR doesn't include this retinue.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Quaartzz makes three Crystal Spear attacks.

action.name: Crystal Spear
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d6 + 12}) Piercing and Force damage. The spear counts as a +3 magic weapon only for overcoming defenses and interacting with other rules.

action.name: Hurl Spear
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 17} to hit, range 120/360 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 4d6 + 12}) Piercing and Force damage. The spear teleports back to Quaartzz immediately after the attack.

action.name: Spear Torrent (3/Day)
entries: Quaartzz releases raw energy in a 60-foot Cone. Each creature there makes a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw, taking 39 ({@damage 6d10 + 6}) Force damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.

reaction.name: Defend the Prince
entries: When a creature Quaartzz can see targets Crystalle with an attack and Quaartzz is within 30 feet, he teleports to an unoccupied space beside Crystalle and becomes the attack's target.

legendary.name: Spear Attack
entries: Quaartzz makes one Crystal Spear or Hurl Spear attack.

legendary.name: Mineral Step
entries: Quaartzz moves up to half his Speed using Mineral Glide without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendary.name: Crushing Sweep (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature within 15 feet makes a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw, taking 23 ({@damage 3d6 + 12}) Bludgeoning damage and having the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition on a failure, or taking half damage on a success.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (5/Day)
entries: If Crystalle fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, Crystalle reshapes his mineral body into any Huge or smaller creature or object. His statistics don't change except his Size and movement modes. His Ioun cloud remains visible in every form.

trait.name: Crystal Body
entries: Crystalle is immune to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks and magic weapons with a bonus lower than +3. He takes no Lightning damage instead of half on a successful saving throw.

trait.name: Magic Resistance (60 Percent)
entries: Whenever a spell or magical effect would affect Crystalle, roll {@dice 1d100}. On 60 or lower, he is unaffected. His Ioun Stones normally increase this percentage by {@dice 1d8 * 5}, rolled when encountered.

trait.name: Mineral Glide
entries: Crystalle moves through unworked earth and stone without disturbing it. Phase Door deals {@damage 2d10} Force damage to him while gliding.

trait.name: Crystal Regeneration
entries: Crystalle regains 5 Hit Points at the start of his turn while on the Quasi-Elemental Plane of Mineral. If he takes Thunder damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

trait.name: Crystal Susceptibility
entries: Crystal-shattering magic deals an extra {@damage 3d6} Thunder damage. A Glassee effect gives Crystalle the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition for 3 rounds. Stone to Flesh reduces his AC to 20 until the end of his next turn.

trait.name: Ioun Sovereign
entries: Crystalle has at least 100 Ioun Stones in orbit. The DM chooses or rolls them from the numbered tables. Duplicate stones stack for him. At the start of each turn, he can activate up to three Voluntary or Limited Ioun Stone properties without using actions. An effect that would grasp, suppress, or destroy one of his stones fails unless Crystalle is Incapacitated. His listed CR doesn't include additional damage, healing, or defenses supplied by the chosen stones.

trait.name: Scepter of Fused Ioun Stones
entries: Crystalle's scepter functions only for him as both a {@item Staff of the Magi|XDMG} and {@item Rod of Absorption|XDMG}. It expends no charges and has no maximum stored spell levels. His spells and spell attacks originate from the scepter or his orbiting stones.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Crystalle is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 24}, +16 to hit with spell attacks). He can replace prepared spells after a Long Rest and normally has the following spells prepared:

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Crystalle makes two Crystal Scepter attacks and can cast one cantrip.

action.name: Crystal Scepter
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 19} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}32 ({@damage 4d10 + 10}) Bludgeoning and Force damage. On a d20 roll of 19 or 20, the target must succeed on a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success.

action.name: Prismatic Sphere (1/Day)
entries: If Crystalle is in Bright Light, he casts {@spell Prismatic Wall|XPHB} without components or Concentration, shaping the wall as a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on himself. He and his Ioun Stones can pass through its layers freely.

bonus.name: Reshape
entries: Crystalle uses Shapechanger.

reaction.name: Absorb Spell
entries: When a spell targets Crystalle, he absorbs it through his scepter as a Rod of Absorption. The spell has no effect, and he can cast a spell of the absorbed spell's level or lower before the end of his next turn without expending a Spell Slot.

legendary.name: Scepter Attack
entries: Crystalle makes one Crystal Scepter attack.

legendary.name: Mineral Step
entries: Crystalle moves up to half his Speed using Mineral Glide without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

legendary.name: Cast Spell (Costs 2-5 Actions)
entries: Crystalle casts a prepared spell, spending a number of Legendary Actions equal to half the spell's level, rounded up (minimum 2), and expending the Spell Slot normally.

legendary.name: Ioun Barrage (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Crystalle activates three offensive Ioun Stone properties, choosing their targets independently.
